questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「galvanize」，意思是「激勵；刺激」。

questions.question_text: The committee was impressed by the candidate's ________ response, which effectively tackled the complexities of the issue while avoiding oversimplification.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 委員會對候選人有深度有細膩（nuanced）的回應印象深刻，該回應在避免過度簡化的同時有效地解決了問題的複雜性。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「nuanced」，意思是「細膩的；有細微差別的」。

questions.question_text: While the software promised seamless integration, its implementation proved to be so ________ that several departments reverted to manual systems.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然該軟體承諾無縫整合，但其實施被證明如此繁瑣（cumbersome），以至於幾個部門恢復使用手動系統。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「cumbersome」，意思是「繁瑣的；笨重的」。

questions.question_text: The CEO's response was deliberately ________; he neither confirmed nor denied the allegations but spoke in generalities.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位執行長的回應是刻意迴避（evasive）的；他既不確認也不否認指控，只是泛泛而談。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「evasive」，意思是「迴避的；含糊的」。

questions.question_text: The scholar's argument was both _______ and erudite, earning him the respect of peers and students alike.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位學者的論點既深刻又博學，為他贏得了同儕和學生的尊重。
questions.explanation_zh: and erudite（博學的）是正面評價，earning respect 說明論點有力，incisive（深刻的、犀利的）最能與 erudite 並列。

questions.question_text: The student's performance in the debate was _______; she responded to each challenge with calm precision.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這名學生在辯論中的表現非常熟練；她以冷靜的精準度回應每一個挑戰。
questions.explanation_zh: responded to each challenge with calm precision（以冷靜精準回應挑戰）正是 deft（熟練的、靈巧的）的具體表現。

questions.question_text: The scientist's proposal was deemed _______ due to its speculative nature and lack of supporting data.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 由於其推測性質和缺乏支持數據，這位科學家的提案被認為是不切實際的。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 不切實際的；堂吉訶德式的

questions.explanation_zh: speculative nature and lack of supporting data（推測性且缺乏數據）說明提案不切實際，quixotic（不切實際的）最為貼切。

questions.question_text: The CEO's speech attempted to _______ investor fears amid a declining market.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在市場下滑之際，執行長的演講試圖安撫投資者的恐懼。
questions.explanation_zh: investor fears amid a declining market（市場下滑時投資者的恐懼）需要被安撫，mollify（安撫、平息）最為恰當。

questions.question_text: The rarity of tsunamis in that area has _____ local people into believing it's safe to live on the coast.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 該地區海嘯的罕見性使當地人放鬆了警覺，讓他們相信住在海岸旁是安全的。
questions.explanation_zh: lull into believing（使人在不知不覺中相信）是固定搭配，表示因為長期平靜而放鬆了警覺。

questions.question_text: The pandemic highlighted that waiting for complete information often _____ momentum; decisive action—even imperfect—can preserve agility.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 疫情突顯了等待完整資訊往往會使動能停滯；果斷行動——即使不完美——也能保持靈活性。
questions.explanation_zh: decisive action can preserve agility（果斷行動能保持靈活性）說明等待資訊會造成停頓，stalls momentum 語意完整。

questions.question_text: As the fog began to _____ the valley, the houses slowly disappeared from view.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 隨著霧氣開始籠罩山谷，房屋慢慢從視野中消失。
questions.explanation_zh: houses slowly disappeared from view（房屋從視野消失）說明霧氣 envelope（包圍、籠罩）了整個山谷。

questions.question_text: If you think the problem is with the printer, you're probably _____. The real issue is the software.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 如果你認為問題出在印表機，你可能找錯了方向。真正的問題在於軟體。
questions.explanation_zh: The real issue is the software（真正問題是軟體）說明診斷方向錯誤，barking up the wrong tree（找錯方向）正是這種情況的習慣用語。

questions.question_text: While Athens has always endured _____ summers as Europe's hottest city, it is now witnessing unprecedented temperatures, including record highs in 2024.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然雅典作為歐洲最熱的城市一直忍受著酷熱的夏天，但它現在正經歷前所未有的高溫，包括2024年的破紀錄高溫。
questions.explanation_zh: Europe's hottest city（歐洲最熱的城市）和 unprecedented temperatures（前所未有的高溫）都指向 scorching（酷熱的）。

questions.question_text: While some plants thrive on soil _____, not all are receptive to mixtures containing used coffee grounds.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然有些植物在土壤改良劑中茁壯生長，但並非所有植物都適合含有咖啡渣的混合物。
questions.explanation_zh: soil amendments（土壤改良劑）是園藝術語，指加入土壤中改善其性質的物質，coffee grounds（咖啡渣）正是此類物質。

questions.question_text: The unchecked spread of AI-generated deepfakes on social media makes it even more difficult for individuals to _____ verifiable information.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: AI 生成的深偽影像在社交媒體上不受控制的傳播，使個人更難以辨別可驗證的資訊。
questions.explanation_zh: discern verifiable information（辨別可驗證的資訊）在充斥假訊息的環境中是一大挑戰，compounds the problem 佐證難度加劇。

questions.question_text: The central bank implemented stringent monetary policies to avert the rapid _____ of the national currency.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 中央銀行實施嚴格的貨幣政策，以避免國家貨幣在加速的通膨壓力下迅速貶值。
questions.explanation_zh: losing significant value（大幅失去價值）正是 debasement（貶值）的定義，inflationary pressures 佐證。

questions.question_text: The 200th anniversary of Mozart's death was ______ around the world with concerts featuring his work.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 莫扎特逝世200週年在世界各地以演奏其作品的音樂會加以紀念。
questions.explanation_zh: 200th anniversary（200週年紀念）以音樂會 commemorate（紀念）是最自然的文化活動描述。

questions.question_text: The natural food available would soon be unable to sustain the increasing deer population, resulting in ______ and suffering for the deer.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 可獲得的天然食物很快將無法維持日益增加的鹿群，導致鹿群的飢餓和苦難。
questions.explanation_zh: unable to sustain the population（無法維持族群）的直接後果是 starvation（飢餓）而非其他選項。

questions.question_text: The refugees refused to seek ______ in the first country they arrived in.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 難民們拒絕在他們抵達的第一個國家尋求庇護。
questions.explanation_zh: refugees（難民）尋求的是 asylum（政治庇護），這是難民法律中的固定術語。

questions.question_text: The two years the author has spent writing this book have been a continuous ______ to him.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 作者花在寫這本書的兩年時間對他來說一直是一種持續的啟示。
questions.explanation_zh: writing a book and discovering something 符合 revelation（啟示、領悟）的語境，a continuous revelation 表示持續有新的認識。

questions.question_text: A great deal of emphasis is placed on academic success, but it's not always easy for children to _________ their parents' expectations.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 學業成就被極度重視，但孩子們不總是容易符合父母的期望。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 有（做某事的）興致或體力

questions.explanation_zh: live up to one's expectations（符合某人的期望）是固定片語，表示達到他人設定的標準。

questions.question_text: _______ government regulations, everyone must submit an annual statement of income to the Department of Taxation.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 依照政府規定，每個人都必須向稅務部門提交年度收入申報表。
questions.explanation_zh: in accordance with government regulations（依照政府規定）是法律文件中的固定搭配，表示遵守規定。

questions.question_text: Not wanting his wife to know where he had been, John______ by murmuring something about working overtime.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 不想讓妻子知道他去了哪裡，約翰藉由喃喃提到加班來掩飾。

options.label: B
options.meaning_zh: 掩飾；偽裝（真實想法或感情）

questions.explanation_zh: not wanting his wife to know（不想讓妻子知道）說明他在掩飾，dissemble（偽裝、掩飾）正是這種行為的描述。

questions.question_text: Many people who reach the ____ of their careers find that 'It's lonely at the top.'
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 許多到達職業生涯頂峰的人發現「高處不勝寒」。
questions.explanation_zh: It's lonely at the top（高處不勝寒）說明達到了最高點，zenith（頂點、顛峰）最為貼切；nadir 是最低點，意思相反。

questions.question_text: The _____ of her neighborhood made it hard for Angela to fall asleep at night; therefore, she decided to move to a quieter community.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 她所在社區的嘈雜聲讓安琪拉夜裡難以入睡；因此，她決定搬到一個更安靜的社區。
questions.explanation_zh: made it hard to fall asleep 且決定搬到 quieter community，說明原本環境十分嘈雜，cacophony（刺耳的噪音）最為貼切。

questions.question_text: The five-star hotel concierge team receives excellent reviews from top-tier guests for delivering services tailored to their _____ preferences.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這家五星級飯店的禮賓團隊因為提供針對頂級客人個人特色偏好量身訂製的服務，而獲得極佳的評價。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 具有個人特色的；特異的

questions.explanation_zh: tailored to their preferences（針對其偏好量身訂製），idiosyncratic（具有個人特色的）表示每位客人各有其獨特偏好，最為恰當。

questions.question_text: The revelation of the _____ meeting with the opposition leader has subjected the conservative leader to intense criticism.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 與反對黨領袖秘密會面的曝光，使這位保守派領袖承受了強烈批評。

options.label: B
options.meaning_zh: 時代錯置的；不合時宜的

questions.explanation_zh: revelation（曝光）說明原本是不為人知的，clandestine（秘密的）表示暗中進行的會面，與 subjected to intense criticism 呼應。

questions.question_text: Her daily routine had become so _____ that she longed for an adventure that would break the monotony of her predictable life.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 她的日常生活變得如此平淡乏味，使她渴望一場能打破可預測生活單調性的冒險。
questions.explanation_zh: longed for an adventure that would break the monotony（渴望打破單調的冒險），prosaic（平淡的）與 monotony 互相呼應。

questions.question_text: The new policy _____ the government's commitment to ensuring justice for all ethnic groups.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這項新政策體現了政府確保所有族群獲得公正待遇的承諾。
questions.explanation_zh: embody（體現）表示某事物具體展現某種理念，government's commitment to justice（政府對公正的承諾）是政策所體現的精神。

questions.question_text: After receiving criticism online, the outspoken influencer launched into a ten-minute video filled with emotional appeals and a full-blown _____ against critical commenters.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在網路上受到批評後，這位直言不諱的網紅錄製了一段十分鐘的影片，充斥著情緒性訴求和對批評留言者的連番激烈抨擊。

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: 長篇激烈抨擊；連珠炮式批評

questions.explanation_zh: filled with emotional appeals 且針對批評者，tirade（長篇激烈抨擊）最為貼切，full-blown 強調其激烈程度。

questions.question_text: The rise of mobile devices has brought countless benefits, but it has also been blamed for _____ compulsive behavior in both teens and adults.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 行動裝置的興起帶來了無數好處，但也被指責在青少年和成年人中引發強迫性行為。
questions.explanation_zh: spawn compulsive behavior（引發強迫性行為）表示行動裝置是根源，spawn 常用於描述催生負面結果。

questions.question_text: Public reaction to the minister's speech was divided—some praised his honesty, while others condemned his remarks as dangerously _____ during a tense political moment.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 公眾對部長演講的反應分歧——有些人讚揚他的誠實，而另一些人在緊張的政治時刻指責他的言論危險地充滿挑釁意味。
questions.explanation_zh: condemned his remarks as dangerously… 在政治緊張時刻，belligerent（好鬥挑釁）最符合被批評的語境。

questions.question_text: In an era of constant online feedback, public figures are often judged not only for their actions, but also for their ability to handle _____ with maturity.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在充斥持續網路回饋的時代，公眾人物不僅因其行為受到評判，也因他們以成熟態度應對嚴格審視的能力而受到評斷。
questions.explanation_zh: handle scrutiny（應對審視）是固定搭配，表示承受媒體和公眾的嚴格審查。

questions.question_text: When the scandal broke, the official's hasty attempt to dismiss it as a misunderstanding only seemed to further _____ the public's outrage.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 醜聞曝光後，這位官員急於將其定性為誤解的草率嘗試，似乎反而進一步激化了公眾的憤怒。
questions.explanation_zh: only seemed to further 表示情況更惡化，escalate（使升級）最符合公眾憤怒不減反增的語境。

questions.question_text: Despite the mounting evidence against him, the CEO remained _____, dismissing the allegations as baseless rumors and refusing to engage with the media.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管有大量對他不利的證據，這位執行長仍然頑固不化，將指控斥為毫無根據的謠言，拒絕與媒體溝通。
questions.explanation_zh: dismissing allegations as baseless and refusing to engage 顯示極度頑固，obdurate（頑固的）最為貼切。

questions.question_text: The committee's decision was met with _____ from the public, who felt their concerns had been ignored, leading to widespread protests and demands for transparency.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 委員會的決定遭到公眾的憤慨，民眾認為他們的關切被漠視，引發了廣泛的抗議和對透明度的要求。
questions.explanation_zh: leading to widespread protests 說明公眾反應強烈，indignation（義憤）是面對不公時的自然情緒。

questions.question_text: The scientist's explanation was so _____ that even the most seasoned researchers struggled to grasp the concept, leading to a prolonged debate in the academic community.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位科學家的解釋如此深奧，就連最資深的研究人員也難以掌握這個概念，導致學術界出現了長時間的爭論。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 令人信服的；有說服力的

questions.explanation_zh: even the most seasoned researchers struggled to grasp（連最資深研究人員也難以理解），abstruse（深奧難懂）最為恰當。

questions.question_text: After years of mixed reviews, the artist's latest installation was _____ praised by critics, marking a significant shift from their previous lukewarm receptions.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在多年獲得褒貶不一的評價後，這位藝術家的最新裝置藝術獲得了評論界的高度讚揚，標誌著與之前反應冷淡的顯著轉變。
questions.explanation_zh: a significant shift from lukewarm receptions，resoundingly praised（廣受好評）與 lukewarm 形成強烈對比。

questions.question_text: Following a thorough review of outdated policies, the committee decided to _____ the obsolete regulations to better align with current industry standards.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在對過時政策進行全面審查後，委員會決定廢除這些陳舊的規定，以更好地符合當前的行業標準。
questions.explanation_zh: repeal（廢除法規）是法律用語，表示正式取消不再適用的規定，obsolete（陳舊的）是需要廢除的理由。

questions.question_text: Although the topic was emotional, his _______ delivery, superfluously filled with exaggerated gestures and a theatrical tone, made it hard for the audience to connect with his message.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管話題是感性的，他那矯揉造作的表達方式——充斥著誇張的手勢和戲劇性的語調——讓觀眾很難與他的信息產生共鳴。

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: 矯揉造作的；裝腔作勢的

questions.explanation_zh: superfluously filled with exaggerated gestures and theatrical tone（充滿誇張手勢和戲劇語調）正是 mannered（矯揉造作的）的具體描述，二者互相呼應。

questions.question_text: During the award ceremony, the university president _______ the research team and applauded their groundbreaking discovery.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在頒獎典禮上，大學校長向研究團隊致賀，並對他們的突破性發現表示讚揚。
questions.explanation_zh: award ceremony（頒獎典禮）的場合自然是 felicitate（道賀、祝賀），且搭配 applauded（讚賞）語意一致。

questions.question_text: After years of poor investments and mounting debt, the once-wealthy businessman found himself living in _______, unable to afford even basic necessities.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 經過多年的糟糕投資和債台高築，這位曾經富有的商人發現自己生活在赤貧之中，甚至連基本生活必需品都無力負擔。
questions.explanation_zh: unable to afford even basic necessities（連基本必需品都買不起）直接說明陷入極度貧窮，penury（赤貧）最為貼切。

questions.question_text: During the town hall meeting, she delivered a fervent, _______ plea for climate action. Her contagious voice trembled with urgency and deep conviction.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在市政廳會議上，她發表了一篇熱情洋溢、激昂的氣候行動請願。她極富感染力的聲音因緊迫感和深深的信念而顫抖。
questions.explanation_zh: fervent（熱切的）是同義詞提示，voice trembled with urgency and deep conviction（聲音因緊迫和信念而顫抖）正是 impassioned（激昂的、充滿熱情的）的表現。

questions.question_text: After eating far too quickly, he began to feel an uncomfortable _______ in his abdomen. Evidently, his stomach was struggling to cope with the large meal.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 吃東西吃得太快後，他開始感到腹部有一種不舒服的脹感。顯然，他的胃正在努力應對這頓大餐。
questions.explanation_zh: stomach struggling to cope with the large meal（胃努力消化大餐）描述腹部脹氣不適，distension（腹脹、膨脹）是正確的醫學術語。

questions.question_text: Before publishing the image on the magazine cover, the editors _______ the photo to remove minor blemishes and enhance the lighting.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在將圖像刊登於雜誌封面之前，編輯們對照片進行了修飾，去除輕微的瑕疵並增強光線效果。
questions.explanation_zh: remove minor blemishes and enhance the lighting（去除瑕疵、增強光線）正是 retouch（修飾照片）的具體操作，是攝影和出版業的常見術語。

questions.question_text: The hikers felt their energy sapped by the oppressive summer heat, which seemed to _______ them well before they could reach the summit.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 登山者感到精力被沉悶的夏日高溫耗盡，這種熱氣似乎早在他們抵達山頂之前便已讓他們精疲力竭。
questions.explanation_zh: energy sapped（精力被耗盡）與 enervate（使精疲力竭、削弱體力）意思相同，oppressive summer heat（沉悶高溫）是造成身體虛弱的原因。

questions.question_text: The model's _______ presence, marked by her piercing green eyes and confident posture, captivated everyone the moment she entered the room.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位模特兒引人注目的氣場——以其犀利的綠色眼睛和自信的姿態為標誌——在她一進入房間時便立刻吸引了所有人的目光。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 鬼鬼祟祟的；偷偷進行的

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 引人注目的；令人印象深刻的

questions.explanation_zh: captivated everyone the moment she entered（一進門便迷住所有人）說明她的存在感極強，arresting（引人注目的、令人印象深刻的）最為恰當。

questions.question_text: Despite the project's ambitious goals and detailed proposal, she had a nagging _______ that the team lacked the experience to carry it through successfully.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管這個專案有著宏大的目標和詳盡的提案，她卻有一種揮之不去的疑慮，認為團隊缺乏成功執行的經驗。
questions.explanation_zh: nagging（揮之不去的）修飾一種負面感受，misgiving（疑慮、不安）表示對某事的隱憂，完全符合對團隊能力的擔憂。

questions.question_text: He sheepishly explained his two-hour delay by mentioning traffic and a forgotten wake-up call, but the excuse sounded _______ and lacked credibility.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 他羞怯地解釋遲到兩小時的原因，提到塞車和忘了設鬧鐘，但這個藉口聽起來站不住腳，缺乏可信度。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 站不住腳的；脆弱的（理由）

questions.explanation_zh: lacked credibility（缺乏可信度）直接說明藉口不令人信服，flimsy（站不住腳的、牽強的）最為貼切，常用於形容薄弱的藉口或理由。

questions.question_text: The stark _____ between the corporation's publicly proclaimed ethics and its hidden business practices created deep concern among employees and shareholders alike.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這家企業公開宣稱的道德標準與其隱藏的商業行為之間的明顯矛盾，在員工和股東之間引發了深切的擔憂。
questions.explanation_zh: publicly proclaimed ethics vs. hidden business practices（公開宣稱 vs. 隱藏行為）形成強烈對比，dissonance（不協調、矛盾）最為貼切。

questions.question_text: The seasoned diplomatic expert skillfully managed to _____ the growing hostility between the opposing international parties before major conflict erupted.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位資深外交專家在重大衝突爆發之前，熟練地平息了敵對國際各方之間日益增長的敵意。
questions.explanation_zh: before major conflict erupted（在衝突爆發前）說明外交努力成功，quell the hostility（平息敵意）最為恰當。

questions.question_text: Despite facing numerous physical injuries and financial obstacles, the Paralympic athlete's ________ pursuit of Olympic glory remained unwavering throughout her career.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管面臨無數身體傷害和財務障礙，這位殘奧運動員對奧運榮耀的追求在整個職業生涯中始終堅定不移。
questions.explanation_zh: unwavering（堅定不移的）是對 tenacious（頑強的、堅持的）的同義詞解釋，despite facing numerous obstacles 強調克服困難的堅持。

questions.question_text: In a puzzling _____ from the norm, July temperatures plummeted to record lows, defying the season's characteristic summer warmth.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在一次令人費解的異常現象中，七月的氣溫驟降至破紀錄的低點，挑戰了該季節特有的夏季溫暖。
questions.explanation_zh: defying the season's characteristic warmth（挑戰季節特有的溫暖）說明這是罕見的偏差，aberration（異常、偏差）最為貼切。

questions.question_text: With substantial capital reserves and innovative digital marketing strategies, the young ecommerce enterprise began to _____ in a challenging post-pandemic market.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 憑藉充裕的資本儲備和創新的數位行銷策略，這家年輕的電子商務企業在充滿挑戰的後疫情市場中開始蓬勃發展。
questions.explanation_zh: substantial capital reserves and innovative strategies（充裕資本和創新策略）是 thrive（茁壯成長）的條件，語意連貫。

questions.question_text: After the devastating earthquake destroyed vital infrastructure, the coastal community's _____ spirit shone through rapid rebuilding efforts and mutual support networks.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在毀滅性地震摧毀關鍵基礎設施後，沿海社區透過快速重建工作和相互支持網絡展現了韌性精神。
questions.explanation_zh: rapid rebuilding and mutual support（快速重建和相互支持）正是 resilient（有韌性的、快速恢復的）精神的體現。

questions.question_text: The gubernatorial candidate's blatant _____ during televised debates eroded public trust and triggered a significant voter exodus across all demographics.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位州長候選人在電視辯論中明目張膽的謊言侵蝕了公眾信任，並引發了跨所有人口群體的大量選民流失。
questions.explanation_zh: blatant（明目張膽的）修飾 mendacity（謊言），eroded public trust（侵蝕公眾信任）是撒謊的直接後果。

questions.question_text: While the professor's scholarly lectures clarified complex philosophical concepts for undergraduates, his overly _____ approach sometimes inhibited creative intellectual discussion in the classroom.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然這位教授的學術講座為大學生澄清了複雜的哲學概念，但他過於說教的方式有時抑制了課堂中創造性的智識討論。
questions.explanation_zh: clarified complex concepts 說明教授是說教式的，overly didactic（過於說教）inhibited creative discussion，語意連貫。

questions.question_text: Sophisticated hackers constantly develop new encryption-breaking methods to _____ seemingly impenetrable corporate security systems with alarming success.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 老練的駭客不斷開發新的破解加密方法，以令人震驚的成功率繞過看似無法穿透的企業安全系統。
questions.explanation_zh: circumvent security systems（繞過安全系統）表示不直接攻破而是找途徑繞過，with alarming success 佐證其有效性。

questions.question_text: The philosopher contemplated the _____ nature of earthly pleasures, acknowledging their ephemeral existence against the backdrop of eternal cosmic change.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位哲學家沉思塵世歡樂的短暫本質，在永恆宇宙變化的背景下承認其短暫的存在。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 難以矯正的；屢教不改的

questions.explanation_zh: ephemeral existence（短暫的存在）與 transient（短暫的、瞬息即逝的）意思相同，是同義詞互相呼應的題型。

questions.question_text: The dilapidated table was scratched and_______; a thick book had been wedged underneath its short leg.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 那張破舊的桌子被劃花了，而且歪斜不平（lopsided）；一本厚書被塞在短腿下面。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「lopsided」，意思是「傾斜的；不平衡的」。

questions.question_text: He tried not to look_______ and moved slowly along the back of the room.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 他試圖不讓自己太顯眼（conspicuous），沿著房間後部緩慢移動。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「conspicuous」，意思是「顯眼的；引人注目的」。

questions.question_text: His negative attitude slowly and _______spoiled the atmosphere around the office.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 他的負面態度慢慢地、潛移默化地（insidiously）破壞了辦公室的氛圍。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「insidiously」，意思是「潛移默化地；陰險地」。

questions.question_text: The_______ condition of many of the city school buildings was very shocking.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 許多城市學校建築的骯髒惡劣（sordid）狀況非常令人震驚。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「sordid」，意思是「骯髒的；卑劣的」。

questions.question_text: The candidate's lousy behavior during the debate turned what could have been a victory into a political_______.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 候選人在辯論中的糟糕表現，將本可贏得的勝利變成了一場政治大潰敗（debacle）。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「debacle」，意思是「慘敗；大潰敗」。

questions.question_text: Some accounting firms have been notoriously_______ about the finances in the past.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 過去，一些會計師事務所在財務方面出了名地不透明（opaque）。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 擦傷的；因摩擦而疼痛的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「opaque」，意思是「不透明的；晦澀的」。

questions.question_text: The actor was_______ by the press as a racist scum.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位演員被媒體誹謗（vilified）為種族主義者的敗類。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「vilified」，意思是「誹謗；污名化」。

questions.question_text: The company will _______all your expenses, inclusive of car rental.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 公司將支付（defray）您的所有費用，包括租車費用。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「defray」，意思是「支付（費用）；負擔」。

questions.question_text: We_______ our management system, but the business is doing no better than it was before.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 我們改革了（revamped）我們的管理系統，但業務並不比以前更好。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「revamped」，意思是「改革；翻新」。

questions.question_text: He has tried to_______ and destroy everyone whose viewpoints differ from his.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 他試圖誹謗（calumniate）並摧毀每一個與他觀點不同的人。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「calumniate」，意思是「誹謗；中傷」。

questions.question_text: Helen despised nosy neighbors who tried to ________ into her personal life, bombarding her with intrusive questions about her job or relationships.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: Helen 討厭愛管閒事的鄰居，他們試圖窺探（pry）她的私生活，用關於她工作或感情的侵犯性問題轟炸她。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「pry」，意思是「窺探；探聽」。

questions.question_text: The investigative journalist was shocked when he received a(n) ________ demanding that he reveal the confidential sources behind his recent exposé on government corruption.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位調查記者在收到一份傳票（subpoena）要求他揭露其最近關於政府腐敗報導的機密消息來源時，感到震驚。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「subpoena」，意思是「傳票；傳喚令」。

questions.question_text: After a few too many glasses of wine, Jack became ________, tearfully recounting old stories about his high school sweetheart who had long since moved on.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 多喝了幾杯酒後，Jack 變得感傷（maudlin），含淚回憶著早已移情別戀的高中初戀的往事。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 因喝酒而傷感的；多愁善感的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「maudlin」，意思是「因喝酒而傷感的；多愁善感的」。

questions.question_text: The artist was able to ________ the bustling cityscape with such meticulous detail that every building, shadow, and reflection looked almost lifelike.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位藝術家能夠如此細膩地描繪（render）繁忙的城市景觀，以至於每棟建築、每道陰影和每個倒影看起來都幾乎栩栩如生。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「render」，意思是「呈現；描繪」。

questions.question_text: Sabrina's ________ remarks during the meeting left her coworkers stunned, as no one had expected such biting sarcasm from her.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: Sabrina 在會議中的刻薄（caustic）言論讓她的同事們目瞪口呆，因為沒有人預料到她會說出如此尖銳的諷刺。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 多才多藝的；用途廣泛的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「caustic」，意思是「刻薄的；腐蝕性的」。

questions.question_text: The conference brought together a(n) ________ group of experts, ranging from medical researchers to technology developers, to discuss the future of artificial intelligence in healthcare.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這次會議匯聚了一群各異（disparate）的專家，從醫學研究人員到技術開發人員，討論人工智慧在醫療保健領域的未來。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「disparate」，意思是「迥異的；不同種類的」。

questions.question_text: Jessica tried not to let her younger brother's teasing ________ her, but after hours of his relentless jokes, she finally snapped.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: Jessica 試圖不讓弟弟的戲弄惹怒（vex）她，但在他無休止的玩笑持續數小時後，她終於爆發了。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「vex」，意思是「惹怒；使煩惱」。

questions.question_text: The ________ of online misinformation makes it increasingly difficult for people to distinguish between factual news and fabricated stories.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 網路錯誤資訊的大量盛行（preponderance）使人們越來越難以區分事實新聞和捏造故事。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「preponderance」，意思是「優勢；佔大多數」。

questions.question_text: John disliked overly ________ people, preferring friends and colleagues who were honest with him rather than those who showered him with excessive, insincere praise.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: John 不喜歡過度奉承（obsequious）的人，偏好對他誠實的朋友和同事，而非用過多、不誠摯的讚美淋沒他的那種人。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「obsequious」，意思是「阿諛奉承的；諂媚的」。

questions.question_text: While having a(n) ________ of information at our fingertips is a great advantage, it can also be overwhelming when we try to sift through conflicting sources.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然手邊有大量（plethora）資訊是一大優勢，但當我們試圖篩選相互矛盾的來源時，也可能令人不知所措。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「plethora」，意思是「大量；過多」。

questions.question_text: Mouly _____ one of the conductors of the New Yorker orchestra since 1993, selecting the cover that week after week lends the magazine its unique identity.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 穆利自1993年以來一直是《紐約客》樂團的指揮之一，每週選擇賦予雜誌獨特身份的封面。
questions.explanation_zh: since 1993（自1993年以來）搭配動作持續到現在，須用現在完成式 has been。

questions.question_text: _____ on February 21, 1925, the New Yorker did not always have such lofty ambitions.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 《紐約客》於1925年2月21日創刊，並非一開始就有如此崇高的抱負。

options.label: B
options.text: Founding（現在分詞，主詞需是施事者）

options.label: C
options.text: That was founded（that 引導的子句不能作分詞構句）

options.label: D
options.text: Found（與 Founded 同形，但常混淆）

questions.explanation_zh: The New Yorker was founded（被創辦），分詞構句用過去分詞 Founded，表示被動關係，主詞與主要子句主詞一致。

questions.question_text: Twenty years before the Titanic _____ maritime history, another ship touted as the next great technological feat set sail on the Great Lakes.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在鐵達尼號改變海上歷史的20年前，另一艘被吹捧為下一個偉大技術壯舉的船在五大湖啟航。

options.label: B
options.text: which has changed（現在完成，時態不對）

options.label: C
options.text: was changing（過去進行，強調動作進行中）

questions.explanation_zh: changed maritime history（改變了海上歷史）陳述鐵達尼號的歷史事件，用過去簡單式；before 子句時態與主要子句呼應。

questions.question_text: Built to break speed records, the 91.4-meter freighter dubbed 'the inland greyhound' by newspapers _____ be one of the safest ships afloat.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這艘91.4公尺的貨輪被報紙稱為「內陸灰狗」，它是為了打破速度記錄而建造的，本來應該是最安全的船隻之一。
questions.explanation_zh: be supposed to（應該、被期望）是固定片語，過去式 was supposed to 表示原本預期但實際未必如此。

questions.question_text: '_____ how the 300-foot Western Reserve was caught in a storm this far from shore made an uneasy feeling in the back of my neck,' he said.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 「知道這艘300英尺的西部儲備號在距海岸如此遠的地方被暴風雨捲走，讓我後頸感到一陣不安，」他說。

options.label: D
options.text: To know（不定詞，作主詞，但此語境偏向動名詞）

questions.explanation_zh: Knowing how...（知道……）以動名詞片語作主詞，made an uneasy feeling 是謂語，文法結構完整。

questions.question_text: She described their influence on the nation's crises in unmistakably ______ terms, insisting that renewed dependence on their expertise would be both ill-advised and injurious.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 她以明顯帶有貶義的措辭描述他們對國家危機的影響，堅持認為重新依賴他們的專業知識既不明智又有害。
questions.explanation_zh: actively harmful（積極有害）和 ill-advised and injurious（不明智且有害）說明描述是負面的，pejorative（貶義的）最為貼切。

questions.question_text: Some critics argued that her tendency to ______ data that contradicted her hypotheses undermined the integrity of her conclusions.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 一些批評者認為，她傾向於隱瞞與假設相矛盾的數據，這損害了她的結論的完整性。
questions.explanation_zh: data that contradicted her hypotheses（與假設相矛盾的數據）被 conceal（隱瞞），undermined integrity（損害完整性）是直接後果。

questions.question_text: After enduring twelve years of wrongful incarceration on spurious charges of treason, Alfred Dreyfus was ultimately ______, bringing a semblance of closure to one of France's most polarizing political debacles.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在因莫須有的叛國罪名遭受十二年不當監禁後，阿爾弗雷德·德雷福斯最終被宣告無罪，為法國最具爭議的政治醜聞帶來了一絲終結感。
questions.explanation_zh: wrongful incarceration on spurious charges（因莫須有罪名的不當監禁）說明他是被冤枉的，exonerated（宣告無罪）是最終的平反。

questions.question_text: The twins exhibited a stark psychological divergence: one embodied imperturbable composure, whereas the other betrayed a proclivity for impulsive ire, emblematic of a deeply ingrained choleric ______.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這對雙胞胎展現了截然不同的心理特質：一個始終保持沉著冷靜，而另一個卻表現出衝動的憤怒傾向，這正是根深蒂固的膽汁質性情的典型特徵。
questions.explanation_zh: choleric（膽汁質的，指易怒的性格）是心理學術語，temperament（氣質、性情）是描述個人心理特質的正確用詞，proclivity for impulsive ire 佐證。

questions.question_text: The performances of her later years bore a conspicuous ______, betraying a self-conscious artistry more concerned with demonstrating her prowess than embodying the character.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 她晚年的表演卻帶有明顯的矯揉造作，暴露出一種自我意識過強的藝術性，似乎更關心展示她的技巧而非體現角色。
questions.explanation_zh: self-conscious artistry more concerned with demonstrating prowess than embodying character 正是 affectation（矯揉造作）的定義。

questions.question_text: During the national crisis, the firefighter proved himself a true ________ by risking his life to rescue people trapped in the burning building.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在國家危機期間，這名消防員以冒著生命危險拯救被困在燃燒建築中的人，證明了自己是一名真正的愛國者。
questions.explanation_zh: 冒生命危險保護人民，是愛國精神的體現，patriot（愛國者）最符合語境；national crisis（國家危機）為關鍵線索。

questions.question_text: The team suffered a(n) ________ defeat, losing 10-0 in the championship game despite being the top seed.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這支球隊遭受了恥辱性的慘敗，儘管是頭號種子隊，卻在冠軍賽中以10比0落敗。
questions.explanation_zh: 以10比0大敗，且自己是頭號種子，結果如此難堪，ignominious（恥辱的、丟人的）完全符合此情境。

questions.question_text: The mysterious ending of the novel ________ my curiosity, making me eager to read the sequel.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這部小說神秘的結局激起了我的好奇心，讓我迫不及待地想閱讀續集。
questions.explanation_zh: pique one's curiosity（激起好奇心）是固定搭配，使人產生想繼續探索的慾望，與後文「eager to read the sequel」呼應。

questions.question_text: After staying up all night studying for exams, Jake felt ________ and could barely keep his eyes open during class.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 整晚熬夜念書備考後，傑克感到昏昏欲睡，上課時幾乎睜不開眼睛。

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: 昏昏欲睡的；無精打采的

questions.explanation_zh: staying up all night（整晚未睡）導致 lethargic（無精打采、昏昏欲睡），could barely keep his eyes open 是直接佐證。

questions.question_text: The wanted suspect fled to another country, but the authorities worked quickly to have him ________ back to face justice.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 通緝嫌犯逃往另一個國家，但當局迅速行動，將他引渡回國接受法律制裁。
questions.explanation_zh: extradite（引渡）是法律術語，指將在他國的罪犯移交回原國受審，face justice（接受法律制裁）是關鍵線索。

questions.question_text: It is a pity that the beautiful painting was ________ by a deep scratch across the canvas.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 遺憾的是，那幅美麗的畫作因畫布上一道深深的刮痕而遭到毀損。
questions.explanation_zh: marred（損壞、破壞外觀）表示使某物失去美感，a deep scratch（一道深刮痕）是造成損壞的原因。

questions.question_text: The hotel welcomed its guests with a ________ buffet featuring fresh seafood, gourmet desserts, and an endless selection of fine wines.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 飯店以一頓豐盛的自助餐款待賓客，供應新鮮海鮮、精緻甜點以及無限量的精選美酒。

options.label: B
options.meaning_zh: 即將發生的；迫在眉睫的

questions.explanation_zh: 描述新鮮海鮮、精緻甜點和美酒，是典型的奢華款待，lavish（豐盛的、奢華的）最為貼切。

questions.question_text: Economists________ a slow recovery for the global economy after the newly elected president assumes office.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 經濟學家預測新當選的總統就職後，全球經濟將緩慢復甦。
questions.explanation_zh: prognosticate（預測、預言）為正式用語，與 economists（經濟學家）搭配表示專業預測，符合語境。

questions.question_text: My mom was fascinated by the ________ and often read books about astrology and tarot cards.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 我媽媽對神秘學深感著迷，常常閱讀關於占星術和塔羅牌的書籍。
questions.explanation_zh: astrology（占星術）和 tarot cards（塔羅牌）都屬於 occult（神秘學、超自然）的範疇，直接點明答案。

questions.question_text: The scandal ________ the company's image and caused a significant drop in sales.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這起醜聞玷污了公司的形象，並導致銷售額大幅下滑。
questions.explanation_zh: scandal（醜聞）通常會 besmirch（玷污）形象，且後文說明銷售下滑，顯示公司聲譽受損，語意完全吻合。

questions.question_text: The ________ summer evening made it impossible to sleep, as the air was thick with humidity.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 那個悶熱的夏夜令人無法入眠，空氣中瀰漫著沉重的濕氣。
questions.explanation_zh: thick with humidity（濕氣沉重）直接描述悶熱潮濕，sultry（悶熱的）是最精確的形容詞，表示又熱又濕的天氣。

questions.question_text: The doctor advised Jenny to balance her________ routine with more physical activity to improve her health.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 醫生建議珍妮用更多的體能活動來平衡她久坐的生活習慣，以改善健康。
questions.explanation_zh: 需要「增加體能活動來平衡」的生活方式，必定是 sedentary（久坐的、靜態的）習慣，前後語意對照明確。

questions.question_text: The paramedics rushed to treat the patient's ________ caused by a sharp object during a car accident.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 急救人員趕往治療患者在車禍中被尖銳物體所造成的撕裂傷。
questions.explanation_zh: a sharp object（尖銳物體）造成的傷口即是 laceration（撕裂傷），是醫療急救中的常見術語。

questions.question_text: The student submitted her application ________, barely meeting the scholarship deadline.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這名學生勉強在截止時間前提交了她的申請，幾乎踩到獎學金的最後期限。

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: 在最後期限前；勉強趕上

questions.explanation_zh: barely meeting the scholarship deadline（幾乎踩到期限）即 under the wire（在最後期限之前勉強完成）的意涵，為習慣用語。

questions.question_text: I ________ your argument that video games are a waste of time; they can actually improve cognitive skills.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 我對你所說的電玩遊戲是在浪費時間這個論點持有異議；電玩其實能有效提升認知能力。
questions.explanation_zh: take issue with（對……提出異議）後接觀點，說明不同意對方，後文提出「反而能提升認知能力」佐證此立場。

questions.question_text: George Orwell was disenchanted with journalism and the media, claiming they were a propaganda machine to ____ lies to the masses.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 喬治·歐威爾對新聞業和媒體感到幻滅，聲稱它們是向大眾傳播謊言的宣傳機器。
questions.explanation_zh: propaganda machine（宣傳機器）的功能是 disseminate（傳播）謊言，lies to the masses 語意完整。

questions.question_text: During the recent Senate hearing on AI regulation, lawmakers voiced a ____ of concerns ranging from data privacy to algorithmic bias.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在最近的參議院人工智慧監管聽證會上，立法者提出了一長串關切，從資料隱私到演算法偏見都有涉及。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 一長串；連珠炮式的列舉

questions.explanation_zh: a litany of concerns（一長串關切）是固定用法，ranging from...to... 說明關切範圍廣泛。

questions.question_text: Under the USSR regime, government officials could walk into a special food shop, fill a cart with sausage and fresh fruit, pay a few roubles, and ____ out of the shop.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在蘇聯政權下，政府官員可以走進一家特別的食品店，把香腸和新鮮水果裝進推車，付幾盧布，然後悠然走出店外。
questions.explanation_zh: saunter（漫步、悠閒地走）完全符合官員輕鬆自在的形象，與普通人苦苦排隊形成鮮明對比。

questions.question_text: Before Lego came up with a more efficient system, retailers returned most of the sets unsold in summer and the company became ____ with inventory.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在樂高想出更有效率的系統之前，零售商在夏天退回大部分未售出的套裝，使公司被大量庫存所淹沒。
questions.explanation_zh: inundated with inventory（被庫存淹沒）表示庫存多到難以應付，inundated 是常見比喻用法。

questions.question_text: The 1980s and 1990s were defined by the ____ success of Hong Kong singers, who dominated the pop music scene not only in their local market, but also in the booming island nation.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 1980年代和1990年代的特徵是香港歌手持久不衰的成功，他們不僅主導了本地市場的流行音樂舞台，也稱霸了蓬勃發展的島嶼國家。
questions.explanation_zh: perennial success（持久不衰的成功）表示跨越多個年代都能保持的成功，dominated 和 booming 佐證。

questions.question_text: While traditional Chinese weddings emphasize symbolism and family honor, some modern celebrations have taken on an ____ flair, with lavish banquets and extravagant gold jewelry displays.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然傳統中式婚禮強調象徵意義和家族榮譽，但一些現代婚禮已呈現出炫耀的風格，有著豪華的宴席和奢華的黃金珠寶展示。
questions.explanation_zh: lavish banquets and extravagant gold jewelry displays 是炫富的典型表現，ostentatious（炫耀的）最為貼切。

questions.question_text: ____ atop the Red Hill of Lhasa, Potala Palace is the spiritual sanctuary of Tibetan Buddhism and stands as a testament to the architectural accomplishments of the Tibetan people.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 依偎坐落於拉薩紅山之上，布達拉宮是藏傳佛教的精神聖地，也是藏族人民建築成就的見證。
questions.explanation_zh: nestled atop（依偎坐落於……之上）常用於描述建築的位置，有「融入自然環境」的意涵，符合布達拉宮的意象。

questions.question_text: In a recent security mishap, National Security Adviser Mike Waltz ____ included journalist Jeffrey Goldberg in a confidential Signal group chat.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在最近一次安全失誤中，國家安全顧問麥克·沃爾茲無意間將記者傑弗里·戈德伯格加入了一個機密 Signal 群組。
questions.explanation_zh: security mishap（安全失誤）暗示這是一個意外，inadvertently（無意地）表示並非故意，最為準確。

questions.question_text: ____ in layers of austere wool and illuminated by a single lantern, Florence Nightingale navigated the corridors with a resolute grace to bring solace to the moaning and writhing patients.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 身裹數層樸素的羊毛衣物，在一盞燈籠的照明下，南丁格爾以堅定優雅的步伐穿行於走廊，為呻吟扭動的病患帶來安慰。
questions.explanation_zh: swathed in layers of austere wool（裹著數層樸素羊毛），swathed（包裹）常用於形容身體被布料纏繞或包覆。

questions.question_text: What is the main advantage of writing 'identity texts' for language education?
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 為語言教育撰寫「身份文本」的主要優點是什麼？

options.label: A
options.text: They focus on collaborative learning in schools.

options.label: B
options.text: They facilitate an enhancement of vocabulary and grammar.
options.meaning_zh: 促進詞彙和語法的提升

options.label: C
options.text: They enable students to use language to communicate their cultural identities.
options.meaning_zh: 使學生能用語言表達其文化身份

options.label: D
options.text: They give precedence to Western cultural norms over alternative viewpoints.
options.meaning_zh: 將西方文化規範置於其他觀點之上

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「They enable students to use language to communicate their cultural identities.」，意思是「使學生能用語言表達其文化身份」。

questions.question_text: How is language primarily perceived from the viewpoint of cognitive linguistics?
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 從認知語言學的觀點來看，語言主要被如何看待？

options.label: A
options.text: It reflects rules and structures distinct from human experiences.
options.meaning_zh: 反映與人類經驗無關的規則和結構

options.label: B
options.text: It reveals a stable system that has been passed down from biological evolution.
options.meaning_zh: 揭示由生物演化傳承的穩定系統

options.label: C
options.text: It reveals social construct founded on cultural norms.
options.meaning_zh: 揭示建立在文化規範上的社會建構

options.label: D
options.text: It reflects bodily experiences and broader cognitive processes.
options.meaning_zh: 反映身體經驗和更廣泛的認知過程

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「It reflects bodily experiences and broader cognitive processes.」，意思是「反映身體經驗和更廣泛的認知過程」。

questions.question_text: Which teaching theory places emphasis on interpersonal communication in the classroom?
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 哪種教學理論強調課堂中的人際溝通？
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「Constructivism」，意思是「建構主義」。

questions.question_text: In the Input Hypothesis proposed by Stephen Krashen, what is the ideal type of input for language learners?
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在 Stephen Krashen 提出的輸入假說中，語言學習者的理想輸入類型是什麼？

options.label: A
options.text: Input that is slightly beyond their current proficiency level.
options.meaning_zh: 略高於目前能力水準的輸入（i+1）

options.label: B
options.text: Repetitive input at their current level.
options.meaning_zh: 在其目前水準的重複輸入

options.label: C
options.text: Input that focuses exclusively on grammatical structures.
options.meaning_zh: 專注於語法結構的輸入

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 與學習者目標無關的輸入

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「Input that is slightly beyond their current proficiency level.」，意思是「略高於目前能力水準的輸入（i+1）」。

questions.question_text: How does the integration of technology in the ESL classroom best address diverse learning styles?
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在 ESL 課堂中整合技術如何最有效地滿足多樣化的學習風格？

options.label: A
options.text: Focusing on the instruction of traditional lecture methods.
options.meaning_zh: 專注於傳統講課法教學

options.label: B
options.text: Utilizing adaptive learning platforms that provide interactive multimedia content tailored to individual needs.
options.meaning_zh: 使用提供符合個人需求之互動多媒體內容的自適應學習平台

options.label: C
options.text: Using text-based digital resources, together with minimal audio-video elements.
options.meaning_zh: 使用以文字為主的數位資源，搭配極少的影音元素

options.label: D
options.text: Readdressing classroom interaction by incorporating solitary, technology-based computer tasks.
options.meaning_zh: 以單獨的電腦作業取代課堂互動

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「Utilizing adaptive learning platforms that provide interactive multimedia content tailored to individual needs.」，意思是「使用提供符合個人需求之互動多媒體內容的自適應學習平台」。

questions.question_text: Many people found it difficult to follow because the reasoning was so _____.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 許多人發現很難跟上，因為推理如此錯綜複雜（convoluted）。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「convoluted」，意思是「錯綜複雜的；費解的」。

questions.question_text: As the disease begins to _____ the brain, people may undergo changes in personality.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 隨著疾病開始侵害（ravage）大腦，人們可能會出現性格上的變化。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「ravage」，意思是「嚴重損害；蹂躪」。

questions.question_text: Environmentalists around the world have _____ the organization's efforts to combat climate change.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 世界各地的環保人士讚揚了（lauded）該組織為應對氣候變化所做的努力。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「lauded」，意思是「讚揚；頌揚」。

questions.question_text: Immediately after completing the study of astronomy, he developed some crude instrumentation to detect radiation.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 完成天文學研究後，他立即開發了一些粗製（crude）的儀器來探測輻射。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「crude」，意思是「粗製的；簡陋的」。

questions.question_text: He was an original composer, less cloyingly sentimental than his contemporaries.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 他是一位有原創性的作曲家，比同時代的人少了幾分令人生厭的（cloyingly）傷感。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「cloyingly」，意思是「膩煩地；過度甜膩地」。

questions.question_text: Regardless of the source of the inaccurate headline, credible sources amplified it, resulting in a costly lesson for many large corporations and business leaders.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 不管不實頭條的來源如何，可信賴的媒體放大了（amplified）它，給許多大型企業和商業領袖帶來了慘痛的教訓。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「amplified」，意思是「放大；擴大」。

questions.question_text: Current medical research has shown that with the correct medication, combined with diet and lifestyle adjustments, there is a chance to 'reverse' the disease.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 目前的醫學研究表明，通過正確的藥物治療，結合飲食和生活方式的調整（adjustments），有機會「逆轉」這種疾病。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「adjustments」，意思是「調整；校正」。

questions.question_text: The report highlighted the urgent need for _____ policies, as pneumonia has become the third leading cause of death among seniors.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 報告強調了積極主動（proactive）政策的迫切需求，因為肺炎已成為老年人死亡的第三大原因。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「proactive」，意思是「積極主動的；預防性的」。

questions.question_text: The EU Commission proposed its first _____ tariffs at 25% on a wide range of US products.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 歐盟委員會提出了對多種美國產品徵收首批25%的報復性（retaliatory）關稅。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「retaliatory」，意思是「報復性的；反擊的」。

questions.question_text: Since the feature's release, users have overwhelmed the internet with images in the style of Studio Ghibli, raising copyright concerns.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 自該功能發布以來，用戶已用吉卜力工作室風格的圖像淹沒了網路，引發（raising）版權方面的擔憂。

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: 上升；起床（不及物動詞，不接受詞）

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「raising」，意思是「引發；提出」。

questions.question_text: The director's decision to cast an unknown actor in the lead role proved to be a _____ move, as the film became a huge success.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 導演啟用一位無名演員擔任主角，事實證明這是一個精明的決策，因為這部電影大獲成功。
questions.explanation_zh: 後文說電影「大獲成功」，可見這個決定是明智的，shrewd（精明的）最符合語境；proved to be 表示事後證明確實如此。

questions.question_text: The new vaccine was developed to _____ the spread of infectious diseases in densely populated areas.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這種新疫苗的開發目的是遏制傳染病在人口密集地區的蔓延。
questions.explanation_zh: 疫苗用來「抑制」疾病傳播，curb（遏制、控制）最為恰當；其餘選項語意相反或不符。

questions.question_text: The fast-paced nature of modern society often leaves individuals feeling _____ and disconnected from their communities.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 現代社會快節奏的本質，常使人感到疏離，與社區脫節。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 恢復活力的；煥然一新的

questions.explanation_zh: disconnected from their communities（與社區脫節）與 alienated（疏遠的、被孤立的）意思相近，是同義詞互相呼應的題型。

questions.question_text: With the increasing demands of modern busy life, people often find it difficult to _____ between work and personal responsibilities.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 隨著現代繁忙生活的需求日益增加，人們常常發現很難同時兼顧工作與個人責任。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 同時應付（多項事務）；雜耍

questions.explanation_zh: juggle between（同時兼顧）是固定搭配，表示在多項事務間靈活調配，符合工作與私人生活並重的情境。

questions.question_text: The new policy was implemented _____, leading to confusion among employees.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 新政策被雜亂無章地實施，導致員工之間一片混亂。
questions.explanation_zh: 後文說導致混亂（confusion），表示執行方式很草率，haphazardly（雜亂地、毫無計畫地）最為貼切。

questions.question_text: The museum's latest exhibition showcased an impressive _____ of ancient artifacts from around the world.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 博物館最新的展覽展示了來自世界各地令人印象深刻的各式古代文物。
questions.explanation_zh: an assortment of（各式各樣的）是固定片語，表示種類豐富多元，符合展覽中展示多種文物的語境。

questions.question_text: The judge's ruling set a legal _____ that would serve as a good reference for similar cases in the future.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 法官的裁決樹立了一個法律先例，將作為未來類似案件的良好參考依據。
questions.explanation_zh: set a legal precedent（樹立法律先例）是法律領域的固定搭配，表示此判決可作為日後案件的參考。

questions.question_text: Many political analysts argue that international organizations must work together to _____ global economic crises.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 許多政治分析家認為，國際組織必須攜手合作，以預先阻止全球經濟危機的發生。
questions.explanation_zh: preempt（先發制人、提前阻止）表示在危機發生前採取行動，符合國際合作防範危機的語境。

questions.question_text: Despite his injuries, the soldier remained _____ in his commitment to completing the mission.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管身受重傷，這名士兵仍堅定地致力於完成任務。
questions.explanation_zh: despite his injuries（儘管受傷）強調克服困難，steadfast（堅定的、不動搖的）最能表現這種意志力。

questions.question_text: Many students struggle with time management, so they need to learn how to _____ their responsibilities effectively.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 許多學生在時間管理上有困難，因此他們需要學習如何有效地將責任事項排列優先順序。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 優先處理；排列優先順序

questions.explanation_zh: time management（時間管理）的核心即是 prioritize（優先排序），符合文意；前後語境直接點明需要學習這項技能。

questions.question_text: The professor's theory was met with _____ by the academic community due to its controversial claims.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 教授的理論因其爭議性的主張，在學術界遭到質疑。
questions.explanation_zh: controversial claims（爭議性主張）通常會引發 skepticism（懷疑、質疑），二者語意直接呼應。

questions.question_text: The festival's lively atmosphere was enhanced by the _____ colors and energetic music.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 節慶活動熱鬧的氣氛因鮮豔的色彩和充滿活力的音樂而更加生動。
questions.explanation_zh: lively atmosphere（熱鬧氣氛）與 energetic music（有活力的音樂）搭配，vibrant（鮮豔的、充滿活力的）最為契合，且語意積極正面。

questions.question_text: As Manuel waited impatiently at a red light, late for a community meeting, his daughter noticed a _______ driver struggling to fix a tire.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 當曼紐爾急不可耐地在紅燈前等候、趕著去社區會議時，他的女兒注意到一名被困路邊、正努力修輪胎的司機。
questions.explanation_zh: struggling to fix a tire（努力修輪胎）暗示車子拋錨無法移動，stranded（被困、進退兩難）最為貼切。

questions.question_text: Faced with constant noise, limited space, and frequent human interaction, some city birds become noticeably more _______ than their rural counterparts, highlighting the intense pressures of urban life.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 面對持續的噪音、有限的空間和頻繁的人類接觸，城市鳥類明顯比農村的同類更具攻擊性，凸顯了都市生活的高度壓力。
questions.explanation_zh: intense pressures of urban life（城市生活的高度壓力）是造成 aggressive（好鬥）行為的原因，語境清晰。

questions.question_text: The ongoing _______ in northern Mozambique, has caused widespread fear through violent attacks and territorial ambitions since 2017.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 自2017年以來，莫三比克北部持續的武裝叛亂以暴力攻擊和領土野心造成廣泛恐慌。
questions.explanation_zh: violent attacks（暴力攻擊）和 territorial ambitions（領土野心）是典型的 insurgency（武裝叛亂）特徵。

questions.question_text: The existing tensions between Eastern and Western churches were only _______ by cultural differences, especially disagreements over language and religious practices.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 東西方教會之間既有的緊張關係，因文化差異——尤其是語言和宗教習俗上的分歧——而進一步惡化。
questions.explanation_zh: existing tensions（既有緊張關係）因文化差異而 exacerbated（加劇、惡化），only 強調更嚴重而非解決。

questions.question_text: I honestly cannot think of anything at this moment _______ I would love more than owning a reliable, fuel-efficient car for daily commuting.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 老實說，此刻我想不出任何事情比擁有一輛可靠、省油的代步車更令我嚮往的了。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 關係代名詞，用於人（受格）

options.label: B
options.meaning_zh: 關係代名詞，可代替人或物

questions.explanation_zh: 先行詞 anything 後用 that 引導關係子句，且在關係子句中作受詞，用 that 最為標準。

questions.question_text: Because the weather forecast predicts heavy rain this afternoon, we shall definitely take an umbrella with us _______ we don't get wet during our walk in the park.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 由於天氣預報預測今天下午會有大雨，我們一定要帶傘，以便在公園散步時不會被淋濕。
questions.explanation_zh: so that 引導目的子句，表示「為了達到某個目的」，we don't get wet（不被淋濕）是帶傘的目的，語意最為完整。

questions.question_text: Our carefully selected top choices cover all the essentials, _______ that you are fully equipped and prepared for any type of adventurous journey you undertake.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 我們精心挑選的首選清單涵蓋了所有必要事項，確保您為任何類型的冒險旅程做好完全的準備。
questions.explanation_zh: 逗號後用現在分詞 ensuring 作分詞構句，表示伴隨的結果，主詞與主要子句一致，文法正確。

questions.question_text: Unlike a traditional tent-and-pole campsite, camping à la automobile is more convenient, great for last-minute adventures, and _______ you to pack as heavy or as light as you would like.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 與傳統帳篷和營柱式的露營地不同，汽車露營更為便利，適合臨時起意的冒險，並允許你隨心所欲地多帶或少帶行李。
questions.explanation_zh: 主詞是 camping à la automobile（單數主詞），動詞須用第三人稱單數現在式 allows；and 連接兩個對等動詞 is 和 allows。

questions.question_text: Which statement is NOT related to communicative language teaching? (A) Native-speaker-like pronunciation is sought. (B) Contextualization is a basic premise. (C) Dialogues center around communicative functions. (D) Fluency and acceptable language is the primary goal.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 下列哪項陳述與溝通式語言教學（CLT）無關？（答：A）

options.label: A
options.text: 母語人士般的發音是教學目標（不相關）

options.label: B
options.text: 情境化是基本前提（相關）

options.label: C
options.text: 對話以溝通功能為中心（相關）

options.label: D
options.text: 流利度和可接受的語言是主要目標（相關）

questions.explanation_zh: 溝通式語言教學（CLT）強調流利、真實溝通，而非追求母語人士般的完美發音，故 A 項為不相關的陳述。

questions.question_text: Which type of syllabus includes a compilation of word items as well as multi-word expressions and collocational patterns?
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 哪種大綱包含單字項目以及多詞表達和搭配模式？（答：B）
questions.explanation_zh: 詞彙大綱（lexical syllabus）的核心是 word items（單字）、multi-word expressions（多詞表達）和 collocational patterns（搭配模式），正是題目所描述的內容。

questions.question_text: Within the standard 2W3P model of English instruction, which of the three 'P' components is typically not explicitly mentioned?
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在標準的 2W3P 英語教學模式中，哪個「P」通常沒有被明確提及？（答：A）
questions.explanation_zh: 2W3P 中的三個 P 通常指 Presentation、Practice、Production，preview 不屬於此模式，故為未被明確提及的項目。

questions.question_text: Mr. Harmer said, 'To make this sound, you close both your lips, and then air comes up from the throat, pushing the lips apart in a small explosion.' Which sound is Mr. Harmer trying to model?
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 哈默老師在示範哪個音？（答：A）
questions.explanation_zh: 描述「閉合雙唇→氣流衝開嘴唇→爆音」，完全符合雙唇清塞音 /p/ 的發音方式；/k/ 是軟顎音，/f/ 是摩擦音，/l/ 是邊音。

questions.question_text: Which of the following statements is incorrect? (A) In two-syllable nouns and adjectives, the first syllable is usually stressed. (B) In two-syllable verbs, the stress is on the first syllable like PRESent. (C) In compound nouns we usually stress the first word. (D) We do not stress prefixes or suffixes.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 下列哪項陳述不正確？（答：B）

options.label: A
options.text: 雙音節名詞和形容詞，第一音節通常重讀（正確）

options.label: B
options.text: 雙音節動詞，重音在第一音節，如 PRESent（錯誤）

options.label: C
options.text: 複合名詞通常重讀第一個字（正確）

options.label: D
options.text: 前綴和後綴不重讀（正確）

questions.explanation_zh: 雙音節動詞的重音通常在第二音節，如 preSENT（動詞），而非第一音節；PRESent 是名詞/形容詞的重音模式，B 項陳述有誤。

questions.question_text: Which of the following statements correctly describes the relationship between activities and tasks?
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 下列哪項正確描述了活動（activities）和任務（tasks）之間的關係？（答：B）

options.label: A
options.text: Activities are cognitively demanding, while tasks are cognitive simple.（錯誤）

options.label: B
options.text: Activities provide controlled, guided practice, while tasks encourage production and creative use of language.（正確）

options.label: C
options.text: Activities but not tasks can be personalized according to pupil's interests.（錯誤）

options.label: D
options.text: Both activities and tasks are contextualized with a real purpose and audience.（錯誤）

questions.explanation_zh: 活動（activities）通常是有控制的練習，任務（tasks）則強調語言的真實產出和創意運用，B 選項正確描述了二者的區別。

questions.question_text: _______ is a dual-focused educational approach in which an additional language is used for the learning and teaching of both content and language.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: ＿＿＿是一種雙重焦點的教育方法，以另一種語言同時進行內容和語言的學習與教學。（答：C）
questions.explanation_zh: CLIL（Content and Language Integrated Learning）的定義就是「以目標語言同時教授學科內容與語言」，與題目描述完全吻合。

questions.question_text: Employers who prioritize worker _______ often see a strong return on investment, as initiatives that promote physical health, stress reduction, and work-life balance lead to more productive and resilient employees.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 優先重視員工健康的雇主，往往能獲得豐厚的投資回報，因為促進身體健康、減輕壓力和工作與生活平衡的措施，能造就更具生產力和韌性的員工。
questions.explanation_zh: physical health（身體健康）、stress reduction（減壓）和 work-life balance（工作生活平衡）都屬於 wellness（健康、身心健全）的範疇。

questions.question_text: The world-renowned cardiac surgeon _______ performed the unprecedented transplant procedure, demonstrating complete composure and technical brilliance under intense international scrutiny.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位享譽全球的心臟外科醫生技藝精湛地完成了這項史無前例的移植手術，在強烈的國際矚目下展現了完全的沉著與技術上的卓越。
questions.explanation_zh: complete composure and technical brilliance（完全的沉著與技術卓越）是對 masterfully（技藝精湛地）的具體描述。

questions.question_text: To apply for the research analyst role at the international think tank, candidates must submit a résumé along with documents proving their academic degrees and professional certifications, collectively referred to as their _______.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 申請國際智庫研究分析師職位，應徵者須提交履歷，以及證明其學術學位和專業證照的文件，這些文件統稱為資歷證明。
questions.explanation_zh: academic degrees and professional certifications（學術學位和專業證照）統稱為 credentials（資歷、資格文件），是求職中的固定術語。

questions.question_text: The pharmaceutical company's experimental drug showed exceptional _______ in clinical trials, consistently producing significant therapeutic improvements in patients with treatment-resistant neurological disorders.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這家製藥公司的實驗性藥物在臨床試驗中表現出卓越的功效，持續為患有難治性神經系統疾病的患者帶來顯著的治療改善。
questions.explanation_zh: consistently producing significant therapeutic improvements（持續帶來顯著治療改善）正是 efficacy（功效、有效性）的具體表現。

questions.question_text: The interdisciplinary research team used advanced computational techniques to _______ massive datasets from genomics, weather patterns, and satellite imagery.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這個跨領域研究團隊運用先進的計算技術，將基因組學、天氣模式和衛星圖像的大量資料整合起來，將其對齊並合併為統一的框架，能夠產生即時的氣候適應模型。
questions.explanation_zh: aligning and merging into a unified framework（對齊並合併為統一框架）正是 integrate（整合）的具體描述。

questions.question_text: The investigative journalist's relentless pursuit of truth enabled her to _______ the elaborate financial network of shell companies and offshore accounts.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位調查記者鍥而不捨地追求真相，使她得以揭開由空殼公司和離岸帳戶組成的複雜金融網絡，最終揭露腐敗官員如何藏匿貪污人道主義援助款項。
questions.explanation_zh: unravel（解開、揭開）常用於揭露複雜的陰謀或謎團，elaborate financial network（複雜金融網絡）正是需要被「解開」的對象。

questions.question_text: Amid persistent market volatility and geopolitical unrest, investor confidence continued to _______, leading to widespread selloffs and sharp swings in asset prices.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在持續的市場波動和地緣政治動盪中，投資者信心持續受到侵蝕，導致整個財政季度出現大規模拋售和資產價格的劇烈波動。
questions.explanation_zh: leading to widespread selloffs（導致大規模拋售）表示情況持續惡化，erode（逐漸侵蝕、削弱）最符合信心緩慢流失的語境。

questions.question_text: The revolutionary blockchain technology was specifically developed to _______ the outdated banking system, aiming to replace traditional financial institutions with a faster, more transparent, and secure alternative.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這項革命性的區塊鏈技術專門為取代過時的銀行體系而開發，旨在以更快速、更透明且更安全的替代方案取代傳統金融機構。
questions.explanation_zh: supersede（取代、使過時）表示以更新更好的事物取而代之，與 replace traditional financial institutions（取代傳統金融機構）完全呼應。

questions.question_text: Strict zoning regulations continue to _______ the city's efforts to expand affordable housing, by delaying construction, inflating development costs, and reducing availability for low-income residents.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 嚴格的分區法規持續阻礙城市擴大平價住宅的努力，因為這些規定延遲了建設、推高了開發成本，並減少了低收入居民的住房供應。
questions.explanation_zh: delaying construction, inflating costs, reducing availability（延誤、推高成本、減少供應）都是阻礙的具體表現，encumber（妨礙、阻擾）最為精確。

questions.question_text: The research project entered a prolonged period of _______ after its funding was frozen, with all operations suspended, no personnel activity, and no measurable progress for several months.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這個研究項目在資金被凍結後進入了長期停滯，所有業務暫停、無人員活動，數月內沒有任何可衡量的進展。
questions.explanation_zh: all operations suspended, no personnel activity, no measurable progress（全面停擺）完整描述了 stasis（靜止停滯）的狀態。

questions.question_text: Economists warned that widespread social unrest would inevitably _______ if unemployment continued to rise unchecked.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 經濟學家警告，若失業率持續不受控制地上升，廣泛的社會動盪將不可避免地爆發，因為公眾憤怒加劇，儘管在大規模驅逐和不平等激增的情況下示威活動尚未開始。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 爆發；突然發生（大規模事件）

questions.explanation_zh: social unrest（社會動盪）的大規模爆發用 erupt 最為恰當，此詞常用於描述騷亂、火山、戰爭等突然大規模發生的事件。

questions.question_text: Following the embezzlement scandal and a collapse in shareholder trust, the board made a _______ decision to remove the CEO, with all members voting in complete agreement.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在貪污醜聞和股東信任崩潰之後，董事會一致決定撤換執行長，所有成員投票完全一致。
questions.explanation_zh: all members voting in complete agreement（所有成員完全一致同意）是 unanimous（全體一致）的直接說明。

questions.question_text: After years of market dominance, the tech company grew dangerously _______, resting on its past success and ignoring market shifts, while competitors quickly gained ground through innovation.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在長期主導市場之後，這家科技公司變得危險地自滿，沉浸在過去的成功中而忽視了市場變化，而競爭對手則透過創新迅速搶佔市場。
questions.explanation_zh: resting on past success and ignoring market shifts（沉溺於過去成就而忽視市場變化）正是 complacent（自滿、故步自封）的最佳詮釋。

questions.question_text: In the aftermath of the disaster, volunteer doctors treated hundreds of patients _______, refusing to accept any form of payment for their services.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在災難發生後，志願醫生免費為數百名患者診治，拒絕接受任何形式的報酬。
questions.explanation_zh: refusing to accept any form of payment（拒絕任何報酬）直接說明是免費服務，gratis（免費地、無償地）為拉丁文借詞，完全符合語境。

questions.question_text: After reviewing extensive evidence of bribery and foreign influence, the federal grand jury voted to _______ the former senator on multiple felony charges.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在審查了大量賄賂和外國勢力干預的證據後，聯邦大陪審團投票以多項重罪罪名起訴這名前參議員。
questions.explanation_zh: grand jury（大陪審團）的職能是決定是否 indict（起訴）被告，multiple felony charges（多項重罪）為關鍵線索。

questions.question_text: The manager _______ agreed to the changes proposed by the employees. He wasn't fully convinced but knew it was necessary for the team's progress.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 經理勉強同意了員工提出的變更。他並不完全信服，但知道這對團隊的進步是必要的。
questions.explanation_zh: wasn't fully convinced（並不完全信服）說明他並非心甘情願，reluctantly（不情願地）最為貼切。

questions.question_text: The scientist _______ data from various experiments before publishing the results. The information was gathered over several months and organized carefully for analysis.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位科學家在發表結果之前，彙整了各種實驗的數據。這些資訊蒐集了數月，並謹慎地整理以供分析。
questions.explanation_zh: gathered over several months and organized carefully（耗時數月蒐集並仔細整理）描述的正是 compiled（彙整、編輯）的過程。

questions.question_text: The politician tried to _______ the significance of the scandal, hoping that the public would pay less attention to the issue.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位政客試圖淡化醜聞的嚴重性，希望公眾對此事不予重視。
questions.explanation_zh: hoping the public would pay less attention（希望公眾不予重視）是 downplay（淡化）的目的，二者語意直接呼應。

questions.question_text: According to the HR manager, the applicants for this job are quite young, _______ only in their early twenties, which raises some concerns about their level of experience.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 根據人資經理的說法，這份工作的應徵者相當年輕，其中有一半只有20歲出頭，這引發了對他們經驗水準的一些疑慮。

options.label: A
options.text: half of whom are（關係子句，正確）

options.label: C
options.text: half of them are（代名詞用法不當）

questions.explanation_zh: 前面有逗號，形成非限定用法，需用關係代名詞 whom（指人）代替 applicants，並加上動詞 are，故選 half of whom are。

questions.question_text: Don't make me angry! If I had magic powers, I _______ you into a frog just to teach you a lesson.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 別惹我生氣！如果我有魔法，我就能把你變成一隻青蛙，給你一個教訓。
questions.explanation_zh: If I had magic powers 是與現在事實相反的假設語氣（現在假設），主要子句應用 would + 原形動詞，would be able to turn 符合此用法。

questions.question_text: David was very hungry. After finishing his first hamburger, he asked for _______. In the end, he ate two hamburgers in total.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 大衛非常餓。吃完第一個漢堡後，他又要了另一個。最後，他總共吃了兩個漢堡。

options.label: B
options.meaning_zh: 另外那一個（特指最後一個）

questions.explanation_zh: 吃完一個還想再吃，用 another（再一個、另一個）表示不特定的額外一個；the other 用於「兩者中的另一個」，此處語境不符。

questions.question_text: Mr. and Mrs. Brown have three sons, _______, which often surprises people who assume at least one of them is already married.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 布朗先生和布朗太太有三個兒子，沒有一個已婚，這常常讓以為至少有一個已結婚的人感到驚訝。

options.label: A
options.text: none of them are married（缺關係代名詞）

options.label: B
options.text: of whom none are married（語序較不自然）

options.label: C
options.text: none of whom is married（正確
options.meaning_zh: 關係子句，none 視為單數）

options.label: D
options.text: and none of whom is married（and 使其成為並列子句而非關係子句）

questions.explanation_zh: 逗號後接非限定關係子句，需用 of whom 引導，none of whom is married 是標準用法（none 視為單數，動詞用 is）。

questions.question_text: The students wanted to _______ their progress by setting clear goals and maintaining a consistent study schedule.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 學生們希望透過設定明確目標和維持一致的學習計畫來加速自己的進步。
questions.explanation_zh: expedite（加速、促進）表示使事情更快完成，與 setting clear goals and consistent study schedule 搭配，語意完整。

questions.question_text: The theory, though still __________, offers a promising framework for understanding the interaction between digital identity and social behavior.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這個理論雖然仍尚未成熟，但提供了一個理解數位身份與社會行為互動的有前景框架。
questions.explanation_zh: though still 後接需克服的不足，inchoate（尚未成形的）表示理論還不完整，but 後仍有前景，語意轉折自然。

questions.question_text: Amid the __________ of her daily routine, she found herself yearning for a moment of unpredictability.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在日常生活的平庸之中，她發現自己渴望片刻的不可預期性。
questions.explanation_zh: yearning for unpredictability（渴望不可預期性）暗示生活太過單調，banality（平庸）與後文 monotony 意涵相近。

questions.question_text: The museum's new exhibition offers such an __________ blend of sound, visuals, and interactive elements that visitors often lose track of time.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 博物館的新展覽融合了聲音、視覺和互動元素，提供如此沉浸式的體驗，使得訪客常常忘記時間。
questions.explanation_zh: sound, visuals, and interactive elements 讓人 lose track of time，完全符合 immersive（沉浸式）的定義。

questions.question_text: The instructions provided by the instructor were __________, leading to confusion among students.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 教師提供的指示模糊不清，導致學生之間產生混亂。
questions.explanation_zh: leading to confusion（導致混亂）說明指示不夠清楚，ambiguous（模糊不清）最為貼切。

questions.question_text: The students were __________ in the design of their research, leading to inconsistent and unreliable findings.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 學生們在研究設計上雜亂無章，導致結果不一致且不可靠。
questions.explanation_zh: inconsistent and unreliable findings 是 haphazard（雜亂無章）設計的直接後果，語意呼應。

questions.question_text: Strict quarantine rules __________ travelers to their hotel rooms for seven days after arrival.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 嚴格的隔離規定將旅客限制在飯店房間內，為期抵達後七天。
questions.explanation_zh: confine to（限制在……範圍內）是固定搭配，表示被強制待在某處，符合隔離政策的語境。

questions.question_text: The distorted wail of the airraid siren at dawn __________ the villagers, freezing them in their doorways before the first shells even landed.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 黎明時分，防空警報扭曲的哀鳴聲讓村民陷入恐慌，他們被凍結在門口，甚至連第一顆砲彈都還沒落下。
questions.explanation_zh: freezing them in their doorways（使他們呆立不動）是 terrified（嚇壞了）的直接反應，distorted wail 強調恐怖氣氛。

questions.question_text: A fierce __________ swept across the plateau, erasing all road markings in a whiteout by dawn.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 一場猛烈的暴風雪橫掃高原，到黎明時分，一片白茫茫中所有路標都被抹去。

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: 西洛可風（非洲熱沙漠風）

questions.explanation_zh: whiteout（白茫茫一片）是暴風雪的典型現象，erasing all road markings 符合暴風雪的威力，blizzard 最為貼切。

questions.question_text: The researchers were able to __________ a complex longitudinal study despite significant logistical and funding challenges.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 研究人員儘管面臨重大的後勤和資金挑戰，仍成功完成了一項複雜的縱向研究。
questions.explanation_zh: pull off（成功完成困難的事）最符合語境，despite significant challenges 強調這是一項不容易的成就。

questions.question_text: To enhance participant engagement, the researchers opted to __________ by increasing the compensation for completing the full survey.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 為了提高參與者的參與度，研究人員決定透過提高完成整份問卷的報酬來增加誘因。
questions.explanation_zh: increasing the compensation（提高報酬）正是 sweeten the pot（增加吸引力、提高獎勵）的具體行動。

questions.question_text: The highly radioactive debris emitted lethal gamma rays that continuously destroyed the advanced robots deployed in a desperate attempt to clean up the catastrophic and hazardous mess left behind.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 高度放射性的碎片持續放出致命的伽瑪射線，不斷摧毀被派遣（deployed）去清理那場災難性危險廢墟的先進機器人。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「deployed」，意思是「部署；派遣」。

questions.question_text: Growing up together in Central Asia, Baheer and Medet were the best of friends, but everything changed when Medet reported Baheer to government authorities, leading to his arrest and excruciating torture.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在中亞一起長大，Baheer 和 Medet 曾是最好的朋友，但當 Medet 向政府當局舉報 Baheer，導致他被捕並遭受極度痛苦（excruciating）的酷刑後，一切都改變了。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「excruciating」，意思是「極度痛苦的；劇烈的」。

questions.question_text: Buoyed by their teacher's suggestion, Indiana students wrote encouraging notes that later lifted the spirits of peers coping with fear and pain after a school tragedy.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 受老師建議所鼓舞（Buoyed），印第安納州的學生們寫下了鼓勵的話語，這些話後來振奮了在學校悲劇後努力面對恐懼和痛苦的同學們的精神。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「Buoyed」，意思是「鼓舞；使振奮」。

questions.question_text: A routine cable car ride in Pakistan became an arduous twelve-hour rescue mission after two cables snapped, leaving eight passengers, including schoolchildren, suspended hundreds of feet in the air.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在巴基斯坦的一次例行纜車搭乘，在兩條纜繩斷裂後演變成一場艱辛漫長（arduous）的十二小時救援任務，八名乘客（包括學童）被懸在數百英尺的高空。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「arduous」，意思是「艱辛的；費力的」。

questions.question_text: The peace talks, once filled with hope for resolution, are now mired in endless bureaucracy, with negotiations stalled by red tape, conflicting interests, and political maneuvering.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 曾充滿和解希望的和平談判，如今已深陷（mired）於無止盡的官僚體制中，談判因繁文縟節、利益衝突和政治操弄而停滯不前。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「mired」，意思是「深陷；使陷入困境」。

questions.question_text: A master piano tuner, Franz Mohr was sought after for his intricate knowledge of pianos and great skill developed over decades.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 鋼琴調音大師 Franz Mohr 以其對鋼琴精深複雜（intricate）的了解以及數十年磨練出的精湛技藝而備受追捧。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「intricate」，意思是「複雜精巧的；錯綜的」。

questions.question_text: Olive spent a month in the countryside, recuperating from the operation, allowing herself time to rest and heal.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: Olive 在鄉間度過了一個月，從手術中康復（recuperating），讓自己有時間休息和痊癒。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「recuperating」，意思是「康復；恢復健康」。

questions.question_text: Joyce's home has a well-stocked bookshelf filled with pristine, unread hardcovers, reflecting my love for beautiful books over time.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: Joyce 的家中有一個藏書豐富的書架，擺滿了嶄新（pristine）未讀的精裝書，反映了她長期以來對精美書籍的熱愛。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「pristine」，意思是「嶄新的；完好如初的」。

questions.question_text: The father and his daughter's effusive thanks for returning the prepaid bus pass left me feeling unexpectedly satisfied.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 父親和女兒對歸還預付公車票的熱情洋溢（effusive）道謝，讓我感到出乎意料的滿足。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 熱情洋溢的；過分熱情的

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: 令人厭惡的；引起反感的

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「effusive」，意思是「熱情洋溢的；過分熱情的」。

questions.question_text: The injured elephant calf, Long'uro, innately received support from the herd, as elephants naturally help and care for each other.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 受傷的小象 Long'uro 天生地（innately）獲得了象群的支持，因為大象天生就會互相幫助和照顧。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「innately」，意思是「天生地；先天地」。

questions.question_text: Whenever Amanda and I embark on our journey to the Golden Coast, we enthusiastically capture countless photographs ____ the breathtaking shoreline unfolds before us, showcasing skilled surfers.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 每當 Amanda 和我踏上前往黃金海岸的旅程，當壯麗的海岸線在我們眼前展開時（as），我們都熱情地拍攝無數的照片，記錄下技術高超的衝浪者。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「as」，意思是「當……時候（表時間）」。

questions.question_text: The stranded sailor had been lying unconscious on the rocky shore for hours when, by chance, a passing fisherman spotted him, recognizing the distress signals.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 那名擱淺的水手已在岩石海岸上昏迷躺了（had been lying）數小時，偶然間被一名路過的漁夫發現，認出了求救信號。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 過去完成進行式，表持續到過去某時刻的動作

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「had been lying」，意思是「過去完成進行式，表持續到過去某時刻的動作」。

questions.question_text: Across peninsular Malaysia and the Bornean states of Sabah and Sarawak, the iconic canopy walks have been attracting both domestic and international visitors, offering an unparalleled opportunity to experience the region's rich biodiversity.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在馬來西亞半島及婆羅洲的沙巴和沙勞越州，標誌性的樹冠步道一直吸引著（have been attracting）國內外遊客，提供體驗該地區豐富生物多樣性的無與倫比機會。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 現在完成進行式，表持續到現在的動作

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「have been attracting」，意思是「現在完成進行式，表持續到現在的動作」。

questions.question_text: His convoluted stratagem, replete with manifold deficiencies, will inexorably be effectuated unless we contrive an alternative—manifestly more tenable—by Tuesday.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 他那複雜的策略充滿了各種缺陷，將不可避免地被執行，除非（unless）我們在週二前想出另一個明顯更站得住腳的替代方案。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「unless」，意思是「除非」。

questions.question_text: Though he exudes an air of veracity and steadfastness, be ever mindful that he remains wholly unworthy of even the most infinitesimal modicum of trust.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然（Though）他散發出真誠和堅定的氣息，但請時刻記住，他完全不值得哪怕絲毫的信任。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 儘管如此；然而（副詞，不引導子句）

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「Though」，意思是「雖然；儘管」。

questions.question_text: Not only did Joyce excel academically, but she also demonstrated remarkable leadership, creativity, resilience, and an unwavering dedication to her projects, earning the admiration of both peers and mentors.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: Joyce 不僅在學業上表現出色，她還表現出（but she also demonstrated）非凡的領導力、創造力、韌性和對專案的堅定奉獻，贏得了同學和導師的讚賞。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: Not only...but also 倒裝結構

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: （連接詞用法不符合Not only句型）

questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「but she also demonstrated」，意思是「Not only...but also 倒裝結構」。

questions.question_text: While Australia boasts breathtaking landscapes replete with stunning biodiversity, travelers must remain vigilant; however, the presence of venomous serpents, formidable arachnids, and stealthy predators necessitates caution.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 雖然澳洲擁有充滿驚人生物多樣性的壯麗景觀，旅行者必須保持警惕；然而（however），毒蛇、可怕的蜘蛛和潛伏的掠食者的存在使謹慎變得必要。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「however」，意思是「然而；但是」。

questions.question_text: Due to the relentless downpour and the ferocious gusts that rendered the terrain inhospitable, their meticulously planned camping excursion was ultimately abandoned in disappointment.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 由於（Due to）無情的傾盆大雨和使地形惡劣的猛烈陣風，他們精心計畫的露營郊遊最終在失望中被迫放棄。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「Due to」，意思是「由於；因為」。

questions.question_text: Julia remained silent throughout the high-stakes corporate negotiation, lest an ill-considered remark undermine the fragile discussions and jeopardize the meticulously crafted financial agreement at hand.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: Julia 在高風險的企業談判中全程保持沉默，以免（lest）輕率的言論破壞脆弱的討論，危及精心制定的財務協議。
questions.explanation_zh: 依句意，此處應填入「lest」，意思是「以免；惟恐」。

questions.question_text: To be _______ was her lot; she was destined never to earn enough money to support herself.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 貧窮是她的命運；她注定永遠無法賺到足夠的錢養活自己。
questions.explanation_zh: destined never to earn enough money（注定無法賺到足夠金錢），impecunious（貧窮的）最為貼切。

questions.question_text: The children were told that they should be _______ about strangers offering candy.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 孩子們被告知，對於陌生人提供糖果應該要謹慎小心。
questions.explanation_zh: circumspect（謹慎的、考慮周全的）表示對潛在危險保持警覺，比 wary 更強調深思熟慮的態度。

questions.question_text: Propaganda is a(n) _______ of the truth; it is a mixture of half-truths and half-lies calculated to deceive people.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 宣傳是對真相的扭曲；它是精心計算以欺騙人們的半真半假的混合物。
questions.explanation_zh: a mixture of half-truths and half-lies（半真半假的混合物）正是對真相的 perversion（扭曲、歪曲）。

questions.question_text: His dissatisfaction over the assignment was _______; it was written all over him.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 他對作業的不滿是顯而易見的；這寫在他整個人身上。
questions.explanation_zh: it was written all over him（寫在他整個人身上）說明情緒完全外露，manifest（明顯的）最為貼切。

questions.question_text: To give in to the terrorists' demands would be a betrayal of our doctrine; such _______ would only encourage others to adopt similar ways to achieve their ends.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 屈服於恐怖分子的要求將是對我們原則的背叛；這種姑息只會鼓勵他人採用類似方式達到目的。
questions.explanation_zh: give in to terrorists' demands（屈服於恐怖分子的要求）正是 appeasement（姑息、綏靖政策）的定義。

questions.question_text: Louis XIV was the _______ of _______ elegance; he wore a different outfit for practically every hour of the day.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 路易十四是享樂主義優雅的極致；他幾乎每個小時都換一套不同的衣服。

options.label: B
options.meaning_zh: 縮影 / 裁縫的；服裝的

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: 極致 / 享樂主義的；精緻飲食的

questions.explanation_zh: acme（極致、頂點）搭配 epicurean（享樂主義的）表示他是精緻生活的最高典範，每小時換一套衣服佐證其奢靡風格。

questions.question_text: The magazine is considered a _______ of literary good taste; the stories it publishes are genteel and refined.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這本雜誌被認為是文學品味的象徵；它所發表的故事都是高雅而精緻的。
questions.explanation_zh: genteel and refined（高雅而精緻）說明該雜誌代表文學品味，credential 在此作「標誌、代名詞」解。

questions.question_text: The prisoner was in a state of great _______ after three months in solitary confinement with no bathing.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這名囚犯在三個月沒有洗澡的單獨監禁後，處於極度衰敗的狀態。

options.label: B
options.meaning_zh: 老朽；衰敗（身體或物質的嚴重惡化）

questions.explanation_zh: three months in solitary confinement with no bathing 造成身體嚴重惡化，decrepitude（衰敗的狀態）最為貼切。

questions.question_text: He was the chief _______ of his uncle's will. After taxes, he was left with an inheritance of $20,000,000.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 他是叔叔遺囑的主要受益人。扣除稅款後，他得到了兩千萬美元的遺產。
questions.explanation_zh: an inheritance of $20,000,000（兩千萬美元的遺產）說明他是遺囑的 beneficiary（受益人）。

questions.question_text: When the unpopular war began, only a few citizens enlisted; the rest had to be _______.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 當這場不受歡迎的戰爭開始時，只有少數公民自願從軍；其餘的人不得不被強制徵召入伍。
questions.explanation_zh: only a few enlisted（只有少數自願），conscripted（強制徵召）表示非自願入伍。

questions.question_text: When she addressed the reporters, her beauty, bearing, and elegant garb were belied by the _______ words she uttered.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 當她向記者們發言時，她的美貌、儀態和優雅的裝扮卻被她所說出的粗魯言詞所掩蓋。
questions.explanation_zh: were belied by（與……形成反差）說明外表優雅但言詞相反，uncouth（粗魯的）最能形成這種反差。

questions.question_text: They prefer to hire someone fluent in Spanish, since the neighborhood where the clinic is located is _______ Hispanic.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 他們偏好雇用西班牙語流利的人，因為診所所在的社區主要是西班牙裔居民。
questions.explanation_zh: predominantly Hispanic（主要是西班牙裔）說明該社區居民的主體，解釋了需要會西班牙語的員工的原因。

questions.question_text: The couple had been meeting secretly for years at the hotel, but their _______ were rumored among their friends.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這對情侶在飯店秘密幽會多年，但他們的約會在朋友之間早已有所耳聞。
questions.explanation_zh: meeting secretly（秘密相會）正是 trysts（秘密幽會）的定義，rumored among friends 說明秘密已外洩。

questions.question_text: Although she had _______ about the weather, she had no _______ about her ability to navigate through it.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管她對天氣有所疑慮，但她對自己駕馭天氣的能力毫無顧慮。

options.label: B
options.meaning_zh: 信心 / 疑慮（語意矛盾）

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: 疑慮 / 信心（語意矛盾）

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 疑慮 / 顧慮（正確搭配）

questions.explanation_zh: misgivings（疑慮）about the weather vs. no qualms（毫無顧慮）about her ability，兩詞意思相近但用 had / had no 形成對比，搭配最為自然。

questions.question_text: The _______ manner in which the teacher candidate addressed the school board was a key factor in his rejection; the school board members agreed that enthusiasm is an essential quality in a teacher.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位教師候選人向學校董事會發言的草率態度是他被拒絕的關鍵因素；學校董事會成員一致認為熱忱是教師必備的素質。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 自命不凡的；裝模作樣的

questions.explanation_zh: enthusiasm is essential（熱忱是必備的），他的表現卻相反，perfunctory（草率的、敷衍的）表示缺乏投入，符合被拒絕的原因。

questions.question_text: Despite facing relentless challenges, Susan's unwavering determination and profound resilience forged a spirit so resolute that she seemed almost _____ —untouched by fear, failure, or the passage of time.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管面臨無盡的挑戰，蘇珊堅定不移的決心和深厚的韌性塑造了一種如此堅毅的精神，使她看起來幾乎所向無敵——不受恐懼、失敗或時間流逝的影響。
questions.explanation_zh: untouched by fear, failure, or the passage of time 描述不受一切影響，invincible（無敵的）最為貼切。
