questions.question_text: The executive's _____ over the merger caused investor anxiety, signaling a lack of strategic direction and weakening the company's competitive position in the market.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位主管在合併案上的猶豫不決引發了投資者的焦慮，表明缺乏戰略方向，並削弱了公司在市場上的競爭地位。
questions.explanation_zh: signaling a lack of strategic direction 說明主管態度不明確，vacillation（猶豫不決）最為恰當。

questions.question_text: The movie's depiction of Julius Caesar wearing a wristwatch was a glaring _____ that disrupted the historical accuracy and distracted viewers from the narrative.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 電影中對朱利葉斯·凱撒戴著手錶的描繪是一個明顯的時代錯置，破壞了歷史的真實性，並使觀眾從敘事中分心。

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: 時代錯置；不合時宜的事物

questions.explanation_zh: 古羅馬人物戴手錶是典型的 anachronism（時代錯置），disrupted historical accuracy 直接佐證。

questions.question_text: In order to effectively _____ innovative ideas throughout the organization, leaders must foster a culture of open communication, strategic collaboration, and continuous learning.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 為了有效地在整個組織中傳播創新理念，領導者必須在企業各層級培養開放溝通、戰略合作和持續學習的文化。
questions.explanation_zh: propagate ideas throughout the organization（在組織中傳播理念）是固定搭配，foster a culture 佐證。

questions.question_text: It is _____ upon every leader to prioritize transparency, especially during crises when public trust depends on honest communication and clear action.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 每位領導者都有義務優先重視透明度，尤其是在危機期間，因為公眾信任取決於誠實的溝通和明確的行動。
questions.explanation_zh: it is incumbent upon（……有義務）是固定句型，表示道德或職責上的義務。

questions.question_text: After the scandal, the once-prominent senator was quietly _____ to a minor committee where his influence was minimal and his political relevance steadily faded.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 醜聞發生後，這位曾聲名顯赫的參議員被悄悄降級到一個影響力微乎其微的小委員會，他的政治影響力也日漸消退。
questions.explanation_zh: relegated to a minor committee（被降至小委員會）表示從重要職位被貶，influence was minimal 佐證。

questions.question_text: The billboard's flashing lights _____ dominated the night skyline, drawing unwanted attention and spoiling the view of the historic buildings nearby.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 廣告看板的閃爍燈光突兀地主宰了夜晚的天際線，引來不必要的注意，也破壞了附近歷史建築的景觀。
questions.explanation_zh: drawing unwanted attention and spoiling the view，obtrusively（突兀地）最為貼切。

questions.question_text: Jenny's _____ personality made her a natural team leader; everyone felt comfortable sharing ideas in her presence.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 珍妮友善的個性使她成為天生的團隊領導者；每個人在她面前都感到自在，樂於分享想法。
questions.explanation_zh: everyone felt comfortable sharing ideas 是 congenial（友善的）個性的直接結果。

questions.question_text: To fully _____ the novel's themes, one must consider not only its historical context but also the subtle interplay of narrative voice, symbolism, and character psychology.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 要充分理解這部小說的主題，必須不僅考量其歷史背景，還需考量貫穿全文的敘事聲音、象徵主義和人物心理的微妙交織。
questions.explanation_zh: explicate the novel's themes（闡釋小說主題）是學術分析的常見用語，需考量多個面向。

questions.question_text: Rather than offering a coherent solution, the politician chose to _____ for nearly an hour, masking his lack of substance with grandiose language and rhetorical flourishes.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位政客沒有提出連貫的解決方案，而是選擇滔滔不絕地空談了將近一小時，用誇大的語言和修辭花招掩蓋其言之無物。
questions.explanation_zh: masking lack of substance with grandiose language 正是 bloviate（冗長空談）的定義，for nearly an hour 強調其冗長。

questions.question_text: In South Korea, thousands of junior doctors were on strike to protest at the ______ of plans to add more physicians.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在南韓，數千名初級醫生罷工，以抗議增加醫師名額計畫的強制推行。
questions.explanation_zh: 醫生罷工是抗議政府「強制推行」增加醫師人數的政策，imposition（強加、強制施行）最為貼切。

questions.question_text: We all know the famous ______ that there's no such thing as a free lunch. In life, everything comes with a cost, whether it's time, money, or effort.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 我們都知道那句著名的格言：天下沒有白吃的午餐。在生活中，一切都有代價，無論是時間、金錢還是努力。
questions.explanation_zh: 「天下沒有白吃的午餐」是廣為人知的 aphorism（格言），後句進一步詮釋其意涵，故為正解。

questions.question_text: Before they took action, the kidnappers were shunted into a nearby building and ______ by a team of waiting policemen.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在他們採取行動之前，綁架犯被引導至附近的一棟建築物，隨即遭到一群等候的警察埋伏突擊。
questions.explanation_zh: 警察預先等候、突然行動，ambushed（埋伏、突襲）最符合此場景；shunted into a building 暗示引誘入局再突襲。

questions.question_text: After some maintenance by the mechanic, the broken air-conditioner has been reset to ______ condition.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 經過技師維修後，壞掉的冷氣已恢復到完美如新的狀態。
questions.explanation_zh: reset to pristine condition（恢復到完美如新的狀態）是常見搭配，表示恢復到原本完好的狀態。

questions.question_text: The constant aftershocks remind us that we must stay ______ all the time.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 持續不斷的餘震提醒我們，必須時時保持警覺。
questions.explanation_zh: stay vigilant（保持警覺）是常見片語，面對餘震威脅，保持警惕是最合理的應對態度。

questions.question_text: A 40-year-old man confessed to the uncommon crime of ______, for marrying a second woman when he was still legally wed to his first wife.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 一名40歲男子承認犯下了重婚這一罕見的罪行，因為他在仍與第一任妻子合法婚姻關係存續期間，又娶了第二個女人。
questions.explanation_zh: 在仍有合法婚姻的狀態下再婚，是 bigamy（重婚罪）的定義，後文的描述正是對此詞的解釋。

questions.question_text: She has held a ______ against her former instructor since her ideas had been shamelessly used by the instructor without giving her any credit or acknowledgment.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 自從她的想法被前任指導老師厚顏無恥地挪用卻未給予任何功勞或承認後，她便一直對那位老師懷恨在心。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 沙文主義；極端愛國主義

questions.explanation_zh: hold a grudge against（對……懷恨在心）是固定片語，表示長期的積怨，完全符合語境。

questions.question_text: To ensure safety, the mining company intends to hire ______ to keep order.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 為確保安全，採礦公司打算僱用傭兵來維持秩序。
questions.explanation_zh: 礦場需要維持秩序的武裝人員，mercenaries（傭兵）是受雇作戰或執行保安任務的人，最為合適。

questions.question_text: The company's decision to exploit its workers for profit was deemed _______ by human rights organizations worldwide.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 該公司為謀取利潤而剝削工人的決定，被全球人權組織認定為應受譴責的行為。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 即將發生的；迫在眉睫的

questions.explanation_zh: human rights organizations（人權組織）的評判用語，reprehensible（應受譴責的）最符合道德批判的語境。

questions.question_text: The influencer's engaging content and genuine interactions helped _____ her followers on Instagram at an impressive rate.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 這位網紅吸引人的內容和真誠的互動，幫助她在 Instagram 上以驚人的速度累積粉絲。
questions.explanation_zh: followers accrue（粉絲累積）表示數量持續增加，accrue 常用於描述逐漸累積的事物。

questions.question_text: Since climate change puts pressure on cities to use less energy to heat and cool buildings, the race to _____ apartment blocks is urgent.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 由於氣候變遷迫使城市減少建築物冷暖氣的能源消耗，對公寓大樓進行節能改裝已是刻不容緩。
questions.explanation_zh: retrofit（改裝、翻新）指在現有建築上加裝節能設備，是氣候政策中的常見術語，符合題目語境。

questions.question_text: Our teacher is distinguished for her ______. She has the shrewdness in preparing for various tests and competitions.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 我們的老師以她的敏銳洞察力著稱，她擅長為各種考試和競賽做準備。
questions.explanation_zh: 後句提到 shrewdness（精明）為同義詞解釋，acumen（敏銳的洞察力、機智）與 shrewdness 意思相近，互為呼應。

questions.question_text: The president has been ______ about his words and carefully excised any passages lest he cause offense.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 總統對自己的用詞一直非常謹慎，並仔細刪去任何可能冒犯他人的段落。
questions.explanation_zh: discreet（謹慎的、不張揚的）表示說話小心謹慎，與「carefully excised passages lest he cause offense」呼應；注意不要與 discrete（分離的）混淆。

questions.question_text: Nina is a ______ girl, for at five she can not only read but also recite long poems after a single reading.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 妮娜是個早慧的女孩，因為她五歲就不僅能閱讀，還能在讀一遍後背誦長篇詩歌。
questions.explanation_zh: 五歲就能讀書並背誦長詩，是典型的 precocious（早熟、早慧）表現，後文的 for 引出具體原因加以佐證。

questions.question_text: The residents protested against the ______ from the chemical factory.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 居民們抗議化工廠排放出的惡臭。
questions.explanation_zh: 化工廠常散發難聞氣味，stench（惡臭）最符合此語境；residents protest against（居民抗議）的對象是令人難以忍受的氣味。

questions.question_text: The professor _______ his theory during the lecture and gave only a vague outline of his ideas, leaving the students confounded.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 教授在課堂上只是略述了他的理論，只給出一個模糊的輪廓，讓學生們感到困惑。
questions.explanation_zh: 後文說「gave only a vague outline」（只給出模糊輪廓），adumbrated 意為「略述、概略描述」，完全對應此語境。

questions.question_text: The _______ effects of the medication caused Judy to drift off into a deep sleep, despite the noise and commotion around her.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 藥物催眠的效果使茱蒂陷入沉沉的睡眠，儘管周圍喧囂嘈雜。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 催眠的；令人昏昏欲睡的

questions.explanation_zh: 藥物讓人沉睡，soporific（催眠的）正是描述使人昏昏欲睡的效果，與 drift off into a deep sleep 呼應。

questions.question_text: The escalating _______ of the dictator towards his neighbors was met with growing concern and condemnation from the international community.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 獨裁者對鄰國不斷升級的好戰態度，引發了國際社會日益增長的關切與譴責。
questions.explanation_zh: 描述獨裁者對鄰國的敵對行為，belligerence（好戰性）最為恰當，且 escalating（升級的）與其搭配自然。

questions.question_text: The speaker's attempts to divert attention from the real issue by bringing up _______ points only served to confuse the audience.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 演講者試圖透過提出離題的論點來轉移大家對真正問題的注意力，但這只會讓聽眾更加困惑。

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 難以矯正的；屢教不改的

questions.explanation_zh: divert attention（轉移注意力）暗示提出的論點與主題無關，tangential（離題的、不切要點的）最為貼切。

questions.question_text: The magician's _______ was so skillful and precise that even the most skeptical audience members were convinced of his supernatural abilities.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 魔術師的戲法如此熟練精準，就連最懷疑的觀眾也相信他擁有超自然能力。
questions.explanation_zh: legerdemain 原義為「手法、戲法」，來自法語，完全對應魔術師的技藝，且有「精巧技術」的延伸義。

questions.question_text: The employee completed the tedious task _______, not bothering to put any care or attention to detail into it.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 那名員工草草完成了那項乏味的任務，根本不費心注重細節。
questions.explanation_zh: not bothering to put any care or attention to detail（不在乎細節）直接說明員工態度草率，perfunctorily（敷衍地、草率地）完全符合。

questions.question_text: The subtle hints _______ that there was a dark underbelly to the glamorous facade presented by the wealthy and powerful elite.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 那些細微的暗示表明，富有而強大的精英階層所展現的光鮮外表背後隱藏著黑暗的一面。
questions.explanation_zh: subtle hints（細微暗示）隱含訊息，insinuated（暗示）最為貼切；hints 與 insinuated 語意高度呼應。

questions.question_text: Jason's _______ knowledge of classical literature impressed even the most learned scholars in the room.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 傑森對古典文學淵博的知識，令在場最博學的學者也印象深刻。
questions.explanation_zh: 能讓 most learned scholars（最博學的學者）也感到佩服，必須是 erudite（博學的）知識，與 classical literature 搭配自然。

questions.question_text: The court's ruling set a dangerous _______ for future cases, as it undermined the principle of equal protection under the law.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 法院的裁決為未來案件樹立了危險的先例，因為它破壞了法律面前人人平等的原則。
questions.explanation_zh: set a precedent（樹立先例）是法律上的固定片語，表示此判決成為未來案件的參考依據。

questions.question_text: The _______ atmosphere of the old abandoned mansion was enough to send shivers down anyone's spine, making it clear that the rumors of ghosts haunting the place were not entirely unfounded.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 那棟古老廢棄豪宅令人不寒而慄的氣氛，足以讓任何人脊背發涼，讓人不得不信那裡有鬼魂出沒的傳言並非空穴來風。
questions.explanation_zh: 廢棄豪宅、讓人脊背發涼，sinister（邪惡的、不祥的）最能描述這種陰森氣氛。

questions.question_text: The breathtaking view of the _______ sky from the mountaintop observatory left the astronomers awestruck, as they marveled at the beauty and complexity of the universe.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 從山頂天文台眺望那令人窒息的壯麗星空，天文學家們驚嘆不已，對宇宙的美麗與複雜讚歎不已。
questions.explanation_zh: mountaintop observatory（山頂天文台）觀察的是 celestial（天空的、天體的）景象，與 universe（宇宙）完全對應。

questions.question_text: After the power outage, chaos would_______ as people scrambled to find flashlights and candles, and businesses struggled to keep their operations going without electricity.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 停電後，混亂隨之而來，人們紛紛四處尋找手電筒和蠟燭，企業也掙扎著在沒有電力的情況下維持運作。
questions.explanation_zh: After the power outage（停電後），chaos would ensue（混亂隨之而來），ensue 表示某事之後緊接著發生，語意完全符合。

questions.question_text: The first step to career development should include _______ of personal strengths and interests, so that jobs that suit one's characteristics can be better identified.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 職涯發展的第一步應包括對個人優勢和興趣的評估，以便更好地確定適合自身特質的工作。
questions.explanation_zh: 評估個人優勢與興趣，appraisal（評估、鑑定）最為恰當，是職涯規劃中的常見術語。

questions.question_text: Despite the subtle changes in the design, differences between the two generations of the smartphone was immediately _______ to even the most casual observer.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管設計上有細微變化，但兩代智慧型手機之間的差異，即便是最不在乎的觀察者也能立刻辨別出來，因為新款手機擁有更大的螢幕、更纖薄的機身和升級的相機系統。

options.label: B
options.meaning_zh: 絕對可靠的；永不出錯的

options.label: D
options.meaning_zh: 難以辨認的；字跡模糊的

questions.explanation_zh: discernible（可辨別的）表示差異清晰可見，搭配 immediately（立刻）強調顯而易見，even the most casual observer 也能看出。

questions.question_text: The experienced pilot had to quickly _______ the helicopter to the right in order to avoid colliding with the bird flying directly in front of the aircraft.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 經驗豐富的飛行員必須迅速將直升機輕輕向右偏移，以避免與正從飛機正前方飛來的鳥相撞。
questions.explanation_zh: nudge 意為「輕輕推動、小幅調整方向」，符合緊急但精準地調整直升機飛行方向的情境。

questions.question_text: The thief had a _____ grin on his face.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 那個小偷臉上掛著一抹醜惡的笑容。
questions.explanation_zh: 描述小偷的猙獰笑容，hideous（醜陋的、令人毛骨悚然的）最為貼切，其他選項皆與面部表情描述無關。

questions.question_text: Amid a crisis, it is imperative for employees and entrepreneurs to use their resilience and _____ to come up with effective strategies to face challenges they are confronted with.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在危機中，員工和企業主必須運用他們的韌性與創造力，想出有效的策略來面對所遭遇的挑戰。
questions.explanation_zh: 危機時需要「想出有效策略」，搭配 resilience（韌性），最適合的是 ingenuity（創造力、機智），表示解決問題的能力。

questions.question_text: Neurosurgeons have to be very_______ in everything they do because even a tiny error can cause an irrevocable result.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 神經外科醫生在做任何事情時都必須非常謹慎細心，因為哪怕是一個微小的錯誤也可能造成不可挽回的後果。
questions.explanation_zh: 神經外科手術要求極高的精準度，meticulous（一絲不苟的）最適合，且後句強調「tiny error」帶來不可挽回的結果。

questions.question_text: The police_______ the suspect's faces closely, trying to figure out who was lying and who was innocent.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 警察仔細審視嫌疑人的臉，試圖分辨誰在說謊、誰是無辜的。
questions.explanation_zh: 搭配 closely（仔細地）與試圖看出誰在說謊的語境，scrutinized（仔細審視）最為恰當。

questions.question_text: The general manager of the company refuted the_______ of misdirected investment concerning the decline of sales performance in the first quarter.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 公司總經理反駁了關於第一季銷售業績下滑是因投資方向錯誤所致的指控。
questions.explanation_zh: refuted（反駁）的對象應是被人提出的「指控」，allegation 指尚未證實的指控，符合語境。

questions.question_text: Belinda spent too much time on work to the_______ of her marriage. Now, her husband decided to get divorced with her.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 貝琳達花了太多時間在工作上，以致於損害了她的婚姻。現在她的丈夫決定和她離婚。
questions.explanation_zh: 固定片語 to the detriment of（以……為代價；損害了……），表示工作過多危害了婚姻。

questions.question_text: In spite of its potential danger, many people believe that nuclear energy is a cleaner and more_______ source of energy which will not be used up in a short time.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 儘管具有潛在危險，許多人認為核能是一種更潔淨、取之不盡用之不竭的能源，短期內不會耗盡。

options.label: C
options.meaning_zh: 取之不盡的；無窮無盡的

questions.explanation_zh: 後句提到「will not be used up in a short time」（不會短時間內用完），對應 inexhaustible（取之不盡的）。

questions.question_text: Before engaging in_______ activities, the best way to reduce the risk of strained muscles and tendons is to warm up and stretch.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 在進行劇烈運動之前，降低肌肉和肌腱拉傷風險的最佳方法是先暖身和伸展。
questions.explanation_zh: 搭配需要暖身的運動語境，strenuous（費力的、激烈的）最為恰當，與「strained muscles and tendons」呼應。

questions.question_text: The ______ convent was one of the most distinguished educational institutes in the Middle Ages.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 那座破舊的修道院是中世紀最傑出的教育機構之一。

options.label: A
options.meaning_zh: 極度痛苦的；心亂如麻的

questions.explanation_zh: convent（修道院）在中世紀即已存在，用 dilapidated（破舊的）描述其現況最為合理；其他選項語意不符。

questions.question_text: Getting vaccinated is a ______ measure that makes people less likely to catch a disease.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 接種疫苗是一種預防性措施，能降低人們感染疾病的機率。
questions.explanation_zh: 疫苗用來「預防」疾病，prophylactic（預防性的）完全符合醫學語境，與 measure 搭配為「預防措施」。

questions.question_text: The poor mother was caught in the middle like a doll fought over by two ______ children, each tugging on an arm until the seams threatened to split.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 可憐的母親夾在中間，就像一個被兩個頑固的孩子爭搶的玩偶，每個孩子各拉著一條手臂，直到接縫快要裂開。
questions.explanation_zh: 兩個孩子各拉一條手臂不肯讓步，recalcitrant（頑固的、不服從的）最貼切，表示孩子固執的態度。

questions.question_text: It is a well-known marine biological phenomenon that clownfish live in ______ with sea anemones.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 小丑魚與海葵共生是眾所周知的海洋生物現象。
questions.explanation_zh: 小丑魚與海葵的互利關係是典型的生物學 symbiosis（共生），此為固定的生物學知識點。

questions.question_text: The manager was found guilty of ______ safety regulations, which had caused the death of one worker in the factory.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 那名經理被判定違反安全規定有罪，此違規行為導致工廠一名工人死亡。
questions.explanation_zh: found guilty of（被判有罪）後接 contravening safety regulations（違反安全規定），語意連貫；contravene 為法律用語，表示違反規定。

questions.question_text: The police have collected enough solid evidence for a grand jury to ______ the minister for fraud and embezzlement.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 警方已收集到足夠的確鑿證據，供大陪審團以詐欺和貪污罪名對該部長提起訴訟。
questions.explanation_zh: grand jury（大陪審團）的職能是決定是否 indict（起訴）被告，為法律專業術語，搭配 fraud and embezzlement（詐欺與貪污）完全契合。

questions.question_text: Facing the war with Russia, the Ukrainian government ______ male adults from leaving Ukraine to other countries.
questions.sentence_translation_zh: 面對與俄羅斯的戰爭，烏克蘭政府禁止成年男性離開烏克蘭前往其他國家。
questions.explanation_zh: enjoin 在法律語境中意為「禁止」，烏克蘭戰時禁止成年男性出境，enjoined（禁止）最為準確。
